jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere in the United States. Meet the Team Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Cilium and eBPF. Cisco Isovalent is building the next generation of products for securing workloads and AI infrastructure using advanced technologies across Linux and Windows. Our software agent team builds high\-performance, secure, and lightweight software agents that run across traditional and modern workloads in on\-premises and cloud environments. These agents collect rich information about workloads and system activity, provide network and runtime visibility, enforce security policies, and help protect containerized and endpoint environments. As part of the Windows agent engineering team, you will focus on extending these security capabilities to Windows environments. You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, and cross\-functional teams to develop system\-level security capabilities while contributing to a cross\-platform product spanning Windows and Linux. Your Impact As a Software Engineer on the software agent team, you will develop and enhance runtime security features for a Windows\-based endpoint agent. You will use systems programming, Windows platform APIs, operating system fundamentals, and networking concepts to build reliable and efficient security capabilities that operate close to the underlying operating system. You will investigate Windows platform behavior and interactions between user\-mode and kernel\-mode components while designing and implementing endpoint security and system\-monitoring functionality. You will participate in architecture and design discussions with senior engineers and architects, troubleshoot complex implementation issues, and optimize software for performance and reliability. Because our products operate across platforms, you will also collaborate with engineers developing related capabilities across Linux and other environments. The features you develop will contribute to Cisco Isovalent's ability to provide security, visibility, and protection across modern enterprise, data center, and cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop and enhance runtime security features for a Windows\-based endpoint agent. * Design and implement systems\-level endpoint security and monitoring capabilities using Go, C, and C\+\+. * Participate in architecture, design, and implementation discussions with senior engineers and architects. * Develop software using Windows system programming interfaces, including Win32 APIs, File I/O, and Winsock. * Investigate Windows platform behavior, APIs, and interactions between user\-mode and kernel\-mode components. * Develop multi\-threaded and multi\-process applications and system\-level software. * Debug and resolve complex implementation issues and perform code reviews to improve software quality. * Analyze and optimize feature performance to ensure efficient endpoint operation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand runtime security requirements and translate them into reliable software solutions. * Contribute to cross\-platform security capabilities spanning Windows and Linux environments. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree with 5\+ years of software development experience, or a Master's degree with 4\+ years of software development experience * Experience with systems programming using C, or C\+\+, including multi\-threaded and multi\-process application development. * 2 \+ year’s experience with operating system fundamentals, including threads, processes, file systems, networking, and inter\-process communication. * Experience with Windows system programming, including Win32 APIs, File I/O, Winsock, and familiarity with API hooking concepts. * Experience debugging and troubleshooting complex software systems. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Understanding of Windows kernel concepts and how user\-mode and kernel\-mode components interact. * Experience developing endpoint security, cybersecurity, or system\-monitoring software. * Experience with Windows kernel programming, driver development, or low\-level Windows internals. * Familiarity with malware detection techniques, endpoint protection technologies, or security monitoring concepts. * Experience with network programming and security\-related protocols. * Experience implementing complex systems\-level software features in production environments. * Experience analyzing and optimizing performance for systems\-level or endpoint software. * Experience collaborating with senior engineers and architects on software architecture and technical design decisions. \#LN\-RN1 Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together a  and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada: The starting salary range posted for this position is $167,700\.00 to $245,200\.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation\*, equity, or benefits. Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job\-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process. U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. jobs.title: Information Technology Architect | (Cloud Engineer)
jobs.description: **Information Technology Architect (Cloud Engineer)** **General Description and Classification Standards:** The Information Technology Architect (Cloud Engineer) in the Enterprise Data Services (EDS) team, within the Office of Technology and Digital Experience (TDE), is responsible for architecting, engineering, and operating the cloud and database platforms that support the Department of Aviation’s enterprise data and AI initiatives. This hybrid role combines cloud engineering with database administration: enabling secure, scalable cloud services while administering Oracle, SQL Server, and cloud\-managed database systems, including design, development, implementation, capacity planning, monitoring for availability, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security, upgrades, and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in data engineering and cloud infrastructure, along with the ability to design and deliver reliable, secure, and cost\-effective data platforms that keep airport systems available 24 x 7 x 365 while enabling the airport’s analytics, automation, and AI roadmap. **Supervision Received:** Reports to the Information Technology Director II, Enterprise Data Services, and works with minimal supervision, using independent judgment and initiative. Makes decisions on process and procedure improvements, solutions to reduce system downtime, system maintenance to improve performance and availability, and hardware and software for databases and database application servers. Provides advice on system upgrades and new technology implementation. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** *These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.* * **Cloud Architecture \& Engineering** + Design, build, and maintain cloud architectures, landing zones, and reference designs for enterprise data services, aligned with EDS standards, security requirements, and the enterprise data and AI roadmap. + Enable and manage cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and managed database and analytics services, for airport applications and data workloads. + Plan and execute migrations of on\-premises databases and applications to cloud platforms, including assessment, sizing, cutover, and validation. + Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment using scripting, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines. + Monitor and optimize cloud consumption and costs, and recommend right\-sizing, reservation, and licensing strategies. * **Database Administration \& Operations** + Administer and maintain day\-to\-day operations of Oracle, SQL Server, and cloud\-managed databases, services, and software, including creating user accounts, assigning permissions and schemas, and creating tables and fields. + Configure and maintain database software and environments, ensuring data remains consistent, accurate, and clearly defined, and that security levels comply with Division and Department standards and procedures. + Monitor the overall health, availability, and performance of database systems, services, and data flow, and take corrective action as required to ensure reliable performance. + Perform installation, upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and performance tuning, and resolve database performance, capacity, replication, and other distributed data issues. + Develop and implement data models, database designs, data access code, and table maintenance code, documenting how data elements are defined and used. * **Backup, Recovery \& Availability** + Plan, schedule, and verify backup and recovery procedures, and ensure that required backups are completed. + Restore failed production databases and services through the disaster recovery process, and design high availability and disaster recovery solutions across on\-premises and cloud environments. + Act as a member of a team to ensure 24 x 7 x 365 availability of the Department’s enterprise database systems and cloud services. * **Security \& Compliance** + Plan, coordinate, and implement security measures, including access controls, encryption, and auditing, to safeguard information against accidental or unauthorized damage, modification, or disclosure. + Develop standards and guidelines to guide the use and acquisition of software and to protect vulnerable information. + Ensure cloud and database environments meet security, compliance, and operational resilience requirements, including the protection of Sensitive Security Information (SSI), Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), personally identifiable information (PII), and critical infrastructure data. + Ensure databases and software applications are patched and upgraded to current supported product versions. * **Data Platform \& AI Enablement** + Architect and support the data platforms that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and the AI roadmap, including data integration, pipelines, data warehouses, and secure envi es. * Database Administration: Strong background in Oracle and SQL Server administration, including SQL, PL/SQL, and T\-SQL, performance tuning, replication, and backup and recovery. * Systems \& Security: High\-level understanding of system architectures, storage, and database and cloud security practices, with working knowledge of Azure environment. * Automation \& Tooling: Proficiency with scripting and infrastructure as code (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Terraform) and with monitoring and database management tools such as Oracle Enterprise Manager and Toad. * Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently and to prioritize effectively. * Problem\-Solving \& Initiative: Self\-starter able to use judgment and initiative to undertake activities and resolve complex technical problems with minimal supervision. * Communication \& Customer Service: Excellent oral and written communication skills, the ability to work alone or within a team, and a customer\-focused, responsive approach when serving business units. * Vendor Management: Experience maintaining software licenses and managing vendor maintenance and support agreements. Availability \& Flexibility: Willingness to work extra hours as needed, participate in an on\-call rotation, and respond to after\-hours emergencies. * * **Industry Experience:** Aviation, transportation, or public sector experience with knowledge of FAA and TSA requirements, cybersecurity standards, and airport IT ecosystems. * **Cloud Architecture:** Experience designing and migrating enterprise workloads and databases to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or similar cloud platforms, including networking, identity, and landing zone design. * **Database Platforms:** Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, and cloud\-managed database services, including high availability, replication, backup and recovery, and performance tuning. * **Automation \& Infrastructure as Code:** Experience with scripting (PowerShell, Python, shell), infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep), and CI/CD and DevOps practices. * **Vendor \& Cost Management:** Experience managing software licenses, vendor support agreements, and cloud consumption costs (FinOps). **Work Environment** Typical office setting, with participation in an on\-call rotation and after\-hours support as scheduled or requested. **Lifting Requirements:** Sedentary work : Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. *It is the policy of the City of Atlanta (“COA”) that qualified individuals with disabilities are not discriminated against because of their disabilities regarding job application procedures, hiring, and other terms and conditions of employment. jobs.title: SCADA System Analyst I - Software Specialist
jobs.description: **City Utilities Engineering** **Hours:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; hours may vary ***Do you enjoy using programming, data, and automation to solve real\-world problems? Join City Utilities Engineering and help support the software and control systems that keep Fort Wayne's essential water, sewer, and stormwater operations running.*** **What You'll Do** As the SCADA System Analyst I – Software Specialist, you will help develop, support, and improve the software behind City Utilities' industrial control systems. You will work alongside engineers and operations staff to maintain SCADA applications, databases, process historians, dashboards, data pipelines, and virtualized operational technology infrastructure. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys programming and troubleshooting but also wants to see how their work directly supports critical public infrastructure. **Key Responsibilities** * Configure and support SCADA applications, HMIs, graphical interfaces, and industrial control platforms, with an emphasis on Inductive Automation Ignition. * Create, maintain, and document custom scripts and software integrations using Python, SQL, C, C\+\+, or related programming languages. * Maintain SQL databases, process historians, dashboards, reports, historical trends, and data collection or migration pipelines. * Support control\-system servers, virtual networks, telemetry systems, and industrial communications, including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, and LAN/WAN connectivity. * Troubleshoot SCADA connections to PLCs and field devices using alarms, event logs, historical trends, and communication\-analysis tools. * Partner with engineering and operations teams to identify control\-system needs, develop solutions, document completed work, and support automation projects. * Train employees on SCADA interfaces and custom or newly implemented software solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled software, and assist with their responsible implementation and long\-term management. **What You Bring** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical or Computer Engineering Technology, or another approved engineering discipline from an accredited college or university; **or** * An equivalent combination of education and hands\-on experience. * At least two years of experience in an industrial environment involving industrial control systems, programming, instrumentation, database management, or process automation. **Technical Skills** * Knowledge of industrial control and SCADA platforms; Inductive Automation Ignition experience is preferred. * Experience with SQL databases, queries, and custom database solutions. * Ability to read, modify, create, and document scripts using Python, SQL, C, C\+\+, or related languages. * Understanding of process historians, dashboards, reporting tools, virtual infrastructure, and PLC interfaces. * Knowledge of industrial communications, including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, gateways, routers, and wireless systems. * Basic understanding of industrial instrumentation used to measure level, flow, pressure, and other process conditions. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and teamwork skills. * Ability to explain technical information clearly to engineers, operations employees, and vendors. **Preferred Certifications** * Inductive Automation Ignition Core or Gold Certification. * Candidates without these certifications must have the interest and ability to pursue them during employment. * A valid Indiana driver's license is required when operating a City vehicle. **Work Environment** This position includes a combination of office\-based computer work and occasional work within active utility facilities. Employees may encounter industrial equipment, electrical systems, chemicals, weather conditions, elevated areas, and moderate noise. The position may occasionally require climbing, kneeling, crouching, or lifting up to 50 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Why Work for the City of Fort Wayne?** Your work will support the systems that help deliver safe, reliable utility services to the Fort Wayne community. The City offers meaningful work, opportunities to strengthen your technical skills, professional development, paid time off, health benefits, and participation in Indiana's public retirement program. ***The City of Fort Wayne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.title: Desktop Support IT Engineer II - (Police)
jobs.description: **Description/Duties** ---------------------- ***This vacancy is in the Police Department's Public Safety Information Technology (PSIT) unit for the Desktop Support Assignment.*** The Information Technology (IT) Engineer II class provides skilled technical services in support of installation, configuration, testing, integration, and ongoing support for City applications or infrastructure requiring an in\-depth knowledge of the City’s platforms and environment in support of meeting availability and performance goals. This class applies to Business Solutions and Application Development; Business Analytics; Database; Desktop and Mobile Services; Service Desk; Geographic Information System (GIS); Network; Security; Unified Communications; and Server, Storage, and Backup. This class may perform technical and/or project leadership for a medium\- to large\-size project using the Project Management Office (PMO) standard methodologies or concurrent small\- to medium\-scale project management. This class is responsible for positively and actively participating in team training and demonstrating team skills learned by applying and reinforcing team principles in daily work with functional teams. Common duties include: performing work on multiple assignments simultaneously such as configuration, integration, development, testing, and resolution of problems for systems; assessing, troubleshooting, and following established guidelines in the escalation of hardware, software, and networking problems; initiating and/or maintaining Incident Reports (IRs) using an on\-line incident management system; assisting with research, evaluation, and implementation of new technologies and/or packaged software; installing and supporting hardware and/or software; preparing and/or updating system documentation; controlling changes in system environments to ensure stable and reliable delivery of computer resources; coordinating and mentoring staff; developing and analyzing data for problem resolution and strategic planning; implementing, maintaining, and monitoring systems and their related subsystems; participating in projects and/or leading small\- to medium\-scale projects and activities related to City computer systems, data, and infrastructure; participating in design, programming, installation, and/or implementation of information systems; planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, coordinating, and scheduling processes, procedures, and strategies for systems that function or communicate across multiple platforms; supporting computing processes executed across multiple platforms and/or networks; and utilizing monitoring, forecasting, trend analysis, and/or reporting tools. Ensures all work is done in alignment with City and IT long\-term strategies. This class is also responsible for performing related duties as required. Project management duties may include: estimating task duration and complexity; developing work plans and scheduling target completion dates; informing customer and management of project status; coordinating efforts of team members; reviewing adherence to policies and procedures; and reviewing results with and motivating team members. ***Desktop, Help Desk, and Service Desk Assignment:*** Ensures desktop computers interconnect seamlessly with diverse systems including associated authentication systems, file servers, email servers, application servers, and administrative systems. Provides expert technical services in support of installation, configuration, testing, integration, and ongoing support for desktop applications, local desktop printing and peripherals, and mobile devices. Managing inventory of installed software, managing software licensing, and creating policies and procedures for upgrades; and working with hardware and software vendors to verify timely product delivery and ensure desktop and mobile devices are installed and ready to operate. Provides telephone or email support and manages and troubleshoots hardware, software, or network problems that can be resolved at first call, provides tier 2 support, and recognizes and escalates more difficult problems and logs call activity. Develops trends by monitoring and analyzing incoming calls, problems, and support requests. Manages tasks for medium\- to large\-projects, including project plan development and execution. **Qualifications \& Requirements** ---------------------------------- **Employee Values****:** All employees of the City of Mesa are expected to uphold and exhibit the City’s shared employee values of Knowledge, Respect, and Integrity. **Minimum Qualifications Required.**Any combination of training, education, and experience equivalent to graduation from an accredited college or university with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, such as Engineering or Geography***(by assignment)***. Considerable (3 \- 5 years) computer systems experience in at least one of the following technical support areas: Applications, Database, Desktop, GIS, Network, Security, Server, or Web Support. **Special Requirements.** For this position, an individual receiving a conditional offer of employment from the City of Mesa must pass a background investigation through the City of Mesa Police Department, the Arizona Department of Public Safety, and the Federal Bureau of Investigation prior to commencing employment with the City of Mesa ***(by assignment)***. Because of the confidential, sensitive nature of information handled, successful completion of a background investigation is required ***(by assignment)***.Must possess a valid Class D Arizona Driver’s License by hire or promotion date ***(by assignment)***. **Substance Abuse Testing.** Due to the safety and/or security sensitive nature of the assignment, individuals in this classification shall be subject to pre\-employment or pre\-placement alcohol, drug and/or controlled substance testing as outlined in City policy and procedures. **Preferred/Desirable Qualifications.**Good (1 \- 3 years) project or technical leadership experience is highly desirable and may be required ***(by assignment)***. Customer service and teamwork experience is also highly desirable. Supervisory experience may be preferred ***(by assignment)***.

jobs.title: Survey Crew Chief
jobs.description: *Survey Crew Chief \- Twin Cities* **Company Overview** Civil Site Group is a professional civil engineering, landscape architecture, land surveying and land planning company located in Golden Valley, MN. We provide professional consulting services to the real estate, development, financial and municipal community throughout the Minneapolis/St. Paul Metro and surrounding area. We are seeking a self\-starter, team\-oriented individual that wants to advance their survey career with a highly skilled and notable company. A qualified candidate for this position will be able to develop their career with diverse survey experience on boundary, topographic, ALTA, platting and construction staking projects. Opportunities for professional development and continued education are fully encouraged and financially supported on a company\-wide basis. We have a group with diverse skillsets and backgrounds and are looking to add someone who is eager to learn and grow within our company. **Company Benefits:** Civil Site Group is conveniently located within ten minutes of downtown Minneapolis. At Civil Site Group, we’re focused on working hard and delivering results to our customers, but in the meantime, we take care of our employees. We have a laid\-back office environment and start\-up culture, where employees are rewarded for their ideas and service. We're a profit\-sharing company, offering industry leading 401(k) bonuses to full\-time employees. We offer comprehensive medical and dental plans with HSA options, company paid life insurance, and short\-long term disability insurance. We can accommodate those seeking a 40\-Hour work week and those that want to rack up OT hours. We offer 10 company paid holidays and 15 Paid Vacation days per year as well as cash bonuses during the first year of employment. **Department:** Land Surveying **Reports To:** Director of Land Surveying / Survey Department Manager **Employment Status:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt **Typical Schedule:** Monday through Friday, with early\-morning start times generally between 7:00 and 7:30 a.m. Hours may vary based on project needs, weather, travel, and daylight conditions. **Position Summary** The Survey Crew Chief leads field surveying activities for a variety of residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, and land development projects. This position is responsible for planning and completing accurate field surveys, operating survey equipment, maintaining clear field records, and directing the work of survey technicians and other field crew members. The Survey Crew Chief works closely with Professional Land Surveyors, civil engineers, project managers, contractors, clients, and property owners. The successful candidate will be dependable, safety\-conscious, technically capable, and comfortable working independently in changing outdoor conditions. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Lead a one\- or two\-person survey crew and coordinate daily field assignments. * Review project information, construction plans, plats, legal descriptions, control data, and survey instructions before beginning fieldwork. * Perform boundary, topographic, ALTA/NSPS, construction staking, as\-built, utility, right\-of\-way, easement, and subdivision surveys. * Establish and verify horizontal and vertical survey control. * Locate property corners, monuments, improvements, utilities, site features, and existing conditions. * Complete construction staking for buildings, utilities, grading, curb and gutter, roadways, parking lots, and other site improvements. * Operate robotic total stations, GPS/GNSS equipment, data collectors, digital levels, and related surveying equipment. * Maintain accurate, organized, and complete field notes, electronic data, photographs, sketches, and daily records. * Download, upload, organize, and perform preliminary review of survey data. * Perform field calculations and identify discrepancies or missing information before leaving the project site. * Communicate field conditions, conflicts, access issues, safety concerns, and potential project changes to the appropriate project manager or Professional Land Surveyor. * Direct, train, and support survey technicians and other crew members. * Confirm that fieldwork is performed efficiently and in accordance with company procedures, project requirements, and applicable surveying standards. * Maintain survey vehicles, equipment, tools, supplies, and assigned safety equipment. * Follow company safety policies and use appropriate traffic control and personal protective equipment. * Interact professionally with clients, contractors, public agencies, property owners, and members of the public. * Travel to project locations throughout the Twin Cities metropolitan area and, occasionally, other areas of Minnesota and Wisconsin. * Perform other surveying and project\-related duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * High school diploma or equivalent. * At least three years of land surveying field e cal Requirements** This position regularly requires the employee to: * Stand and walk for extended periods over uneven, steep, muddy, snowy, wooded, or construction\-site terrain. * Frequently bend, kneel, crouch, climb, reach, and maintain balance. * Carry survey equipment, stakes, supplies, and other materials across project sites. * Regularly lift and carry up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift or move up to 70 pounds with appropriate assistance or equipment. * Use hand tools, including hammers, shovels, digging tools, and measuring devices. * Enter and exit survey vehicles frequently throughout the workday. * Work near active construction equipment, roadways, traffic, excavations, water, vegetation, insects, and other outdoor hazards. * Perform work in heat, cold, rain, snow, wind, humidity, dust, and direct sunlight. **Work Environment** Most duties are performed jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer

Reporting to the Technical Content Team Lead and working on a team of writers and creators, you own content end to end, from drafting through publication, partnering with product leads and SMEs to keep documentation in pace with releases. This is a hands\-on writing role: you produce high\-caliber content, continually raising the bar as we evolve with our the fast\-paced AI\-enabled FinTech landscape. **Responsibilities** * Document complex financial technology products for both external and internal audiences, ensuring clients receive content with new SaaS releases. * Draft content live in iterative working sessions with SMEs (product managers, engineers), translating complex financial technology topics into clear, concise language. * Use AI tools to accelerate drafting and editing while maintaining quality and jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cleerly** We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location. Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks. At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description. While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time. *Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.* **Job Description** Our Security team is growing and we have an immediate opening for a Cloud Security Engineer with a strong focus on cloud\-native security architecture and design. In this role, you will lead the effort to design, build, and secure our cloud infrastructure, establish robust cloud architecture security standards, and implement infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) security controls directly across our cloud environments. Reporting to the Director of IT and IS, this role will be a multi\-faceted function that assists in maintaining cloud posture, executing core cloud security functions, and acting as a technical expert in architecting secure, scalable cloud systems. The ideal candidate is a self\-motivated individual that is great at task and time management, and is excited to build cloud security directly into our infrastructure from the ground up. **What would I be doing?** As a key member of the Security team, you will collaborate closely with engineering and security leadership to design, build, and maintain secure cloud architecture. You will drive cloud\-native security initiatives by embedding infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) security controls, automated compliance scanning, and cloud configuration hardening across all environments, serving as a cross\-functional partner to ensure robust security throughout our cloud ecosystem. On any given day you could be: * Monitor and analyze cloud\-specific threat landscapes; proactively identify and mitigate risks related to public cloud service misconfigurations. * Maintain cloud security posture by monitoring and triaging alerts from CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management) and cloud\-native security tools; conduct forensic investigations. * Work in a cross function capacity with our DevOps team to automate security monitoring and alerting solutions directly into the CI/CD pipeline using Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * Integrate automated vulnerability scanning and security testing directly into the development lifecycle to ensure continuous security feedback for engineering teams. * Coordinate cross\-functional teams for vulnerability remediation efforts. * Design and audit cloud\-native security controls to ensure continuous compliance and adherence to regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC). * Proactively monitor and evaluate security configurations of systems and applications for continuous improvement and compliance. * Participate in the full security incident response lifecycle, including containment, eradication, and recovery. * Partner with software engineering teams to provide security design consultation, embedding secure\-by\-design principles into cloud architecture and application features. **Qualifications** * 5 to 8\+ years of dedicated Security Engineering experience with a strong focus on AWS security, cloud\-native architecture, and DevSecOps * Demonstrated experience building and architecting security infrastructure from the ground up, serving as the primary architect and functional owner of the security domain * Proven track record implementing cloud\-native security tooling (e.g., CSPM, CWPP) and embedding automated security controls into CI/CD deployment pipelines * Proficiency in Python, Terraform, and Containerization strategies such as Kubernetes and Docker * Strong understanding of SaaS risk management and hardening processes as well as experience in DLP implementations and management * Previous experience working within a startup environment, with excellent verbal and written communication skills to address security concerns across internal stakeholders **Impress us more** * CISSP, CNAPP, or related certifications * Experience in development or implementation of new tooling using the latest available resources or technologies * Experience implementation or use of CSPM tools such as Wiz, Orca, or AWS security tools suite * Experience with implementation and tuning of SIEM and event management tools * Experience in the digital healthcare industry The base salary range for this role varies by location and is aligned to market benchmarks. * Candidates located in **higher\-cost labor markets**, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in **all other U.S. locations** represent the low to middle end of the range. * Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity. This role is eligible for a 10**% target annual bonus**, resulting in the following **base salary** and **Total Target Compensation (TTC)** ranges: * **Base Salary:** ***$125,000 \- $175,000*** * Total Target Compensation (TTC): Total Cash Compensation (including base pay, variable pay, commission, bonuses, etc.) Additionally, stock options, paid benefits, and employee perks are part of your total rewards. **Working at Cleerly takes HEART. Discover our Core Values:** * **H: Humility**\- be a servant leader * **E: Excellence**\- deliver world\-changing results * **A: Accountability**\- do what you say; expect the same from others * **R: Remarkable**\- inspire \& innovate with impact * **T: Teamwork**\- together we win Don't meet 100 percent of the qualifications? Apply anyway and help us diversify our candidate pool and workforce. We value experience, whether gained formally or informally on the job or through other experiences. *Job duties, activities and responsibilities are subject to change by our company.* ***OUR COMPANY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.*** *We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.* For more information see our Privacy Policy (https://cleerlyhealth.com/privacy\-policy). All official emails will come from @cleerlyhealth.com email accounts. \#Cleerly

jobs.title: Forklift Operator
jobs.description: At Clopay Corporation, we are more than just North America’s largest residential and commercial garage door manufacturer, we are a powerhouse of innovation, safety, and design. Through our premier brands, we lead the industry in providing groundbreaking high\-performance closure solutions for both the places people call home and the spaces where the world does business. Headquartered in Mason, Ohio, and operating state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Troy, Ohio, Mountaintop, Pennsylvania, and Goodyear, Arizona, we are a proud American\-owned company and a wholly\-owned subsidiary of Griffon Corporation. Our reach extends across 55\+ distribution centers and thousands of retail locations in the U.S. and Canada ensuring that we deliver the right door for every opening – from homes to businesses and beyond. By joining our team, you become part of a legacy that blends the residential elegance of Clopay, known as "America’s Favorite Garage Doors," with the industrial strength and 180\-year heritage of our rolling brands, Cornell and Cookson. Together, we secure everything from family garages to the world's most iconic stadiums and skyscrapers. We currently have openings for Forklift Operators / Material Handlers in our Troy, Ohio location. The starting pay for a Forklift Operator is $19\.40 plus $1\.00 shift differential. Wage increases up to $25\.61 after 24 months. Shift Schedule: * 2nd shift hours Monday – Friday 3pm\-11pm. * 3rd shift hours Monday – Friday 11pm\-7am. Weekends (Friday, Saturday, Sunday) 7am\-7pm. * Responsibilities include: * Unload incoming shipments off trucks. * Compare incoming shipments against bills of lading, invoices, or other records to verify accuracy of order. * Unpack and examine incoming product for damage; move materials to correct storage area or department. * Maintain accurate inventory records by scanning materials moved in and out of warehouse, and completing sub inventory transfers. * Convey incoming materials from receiving platform to storage or work areas by using forklift, tow motor, hand trucks or other devices. * Perform inventory as required; inform supervisor of any shortages. * Follow prescribed safety regulations. * Maintain the work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition. Perform other job\-related duties and activities as needed. * Qualifications: * Qualified candidates must possess a High School diploma or equivalent, must be able to lift 50lbs, and have the ability to work at a quick pace. * Proven experience in warehouse operations. * Forklift operation certification. * Proficient in using RF scanners. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. * Why Choose a Career With Us? We don't just manufacture doors; we engineer the "front door" of the American dream and the security of global commerce. At Clopay, we believe our strength lies in our people. From our design engineers to our manufacturing associates and delivery drivers, every member of the team plays a vital role in our success. Our team members thrive because we prioritize: * Unrivaled Scale: Work for a market leader with a massive manufacturing footprint and a reputation for excellence that spans nearly two centuries. * A Culture of "What’s Next": We invest heavily in automation, sustainable materials, and smart\-home integration to stay ahead of the curve. * Commitment to People: As a Griffon Corporation company, we provide the stability of a large organization with the tight\-knit, collaborative feel of a specialized craft team. * A Legacy of Expertise: Join our "Pioneer Club"—a group of over 440 employees who have been with us for 20 years or more. We offer the stability of a market leader and a place where you can truly grow a lifelong career. * Commitment to Innovation: We aren’t just keeping up with industry trends; we’re setting them. Whether it’s our exclusive WINDCODE® technology or our award\-winning designs, we provide the tools for you to do your best work. Community Focused: Our success is linked to the well\-being of our neighbors and communities. Through our partnership with Habitat for Humanity, Clopay employees help provide homes and security to families in the communities where we live and work. * Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description: Senior DevOps Engineer \- Matterport Job Description **Overview** CoStar Group (CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S\&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives. We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings for our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate. **About Matterport** Matterport is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our spatial computing platform turns buildings into data, making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings across more than 170 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins, supporting every stage of the building lifecycle including planning, construction, operations, documentation, appraisal, and marketing. We are currently seeking an accomplished **Senior DevOps \& Infrastructure Engineer** to join our team, crafting and scaling cloud services while supporting our multiple software products and brands across the organization, such as Matterport, Debt Solutions, CoStar Suites, LoopNet, Apartments.com, Homes.com, and Ten\-X. Motivates team members and assesses performance, keeps management updated on team performance. * **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree required from an accredited, in\-person, not for profit university or college. * A track record of commitment to prior employers. * 5\+ years of a healthy mix of development and DevOps experience with cloud service providers (AWS/Azure/GCP), Docker containers, and Kubernetes, including experience managing heavy web traffic sites using mass scale architecture with a developer focus. * Solid sizing and estimation techniques for small to medium size tasks and projects. * Infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar platforms. * Expert experience with open\-source technologies (such as Linux, APT, and others) and automation tools (Chef, Puppet, Ansible, or Saltstack). * Expert container experience with Docker and Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms is a must. * Advanced experience of CI/CD pipelines to a wide variety of virtual environments in public cloud providers. * Strong ability to code your way out of problems using Python, Ruby, Go, PowerShell, or Bash. * 3 to 5 years managing monitoring, centralized logging, and reporting systems, building dashboards on application and server performance and scalability issues (examples: Datadog, SignalFX, New Relic, or other operations monitoring tools). * Conceptual understanding of SQL and No SQL databases, with the ability to evaluate and select appropriate solutions based on performance, cost and technical fit. * Experience with configuring Content Delivery Networks (CDN) for performance caching and global traffic management. * Familiarity with infrastructure foundation components of large networks in AWS. * Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts and practical application as it applies to improving workflows, observability and team efficiency. Good verbal and written communication skills and enjoys working in a global team. * **Nice to Haves** * Experience with enterprise monitoring tools in areas of APM, system vitals, synthetics and RUM. * Programming languages / some developer background with Java, C\#, Python, or NodeJS. * Serverless architecture methodologies. * Familiarity with PCI compliance and remediation. * Mobile application support (iOS, Android). * Experience in REST API or Microservices development. Agile methodologies and working on short sprint cycles. * **What’s in it for You** When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed. We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full\-time in the United States to apply. However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. \#CoStar \#LI\-CG4 CoStar Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer; we maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment substance abuse testing

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - PSA Liquidity
jobs.description: Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France. As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process. We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have. **Senior Software Engineer, PSA Liquidity Platform** ==================================================== **About Collectors** -------------------- Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items, and today we employ more than 3,000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France. We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our Product \& Engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the PSA Liquidity Platform — the product suite that connects supply and demand across our marketplace, including PSA Partner Offers and our eBay Consignment platform. PSA Partner Offers is a first\-party marketplace that sources offers from our network of buyers and surfaces them as instant, targeted offers to grading and vault customers. Our eBay consignment business allows customers to seamlessly sell on the world's largest marketplace while we handle every step of fulfillment as eBay's official vault partner. You'll own the technical design and delivery of the end\-to\-end buyer and seller experiences, partnering with a dedicated cross\-functional team (business, product, engineering, design, data) to seamlessly connect supply and demand. This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact role on our Marketplace engineering team, building systems that maximize GMV, conversion, and offer\-to\-sale velocity at scale. We believe there is significant value in onsite partnership and team collaboration, and candidates within 1\-hour commuting distance of the office may be expected to work onsite most of the time. Additional details will be discussed during the recruiting process. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build powerful buyer tooling.** Lead development of our next\-generation buyer platform: targeting, campaign management, budget controls, and analytics that let every type of buyer — from individual collectors to large\-scale dealers — discover and acquire the right cards at scale. * **Build and optimize the offer pricing engine.** Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to build a sophisticated, real\-time targeting and ranking engine that maximizes marketplace GMV, conversion, and offer\-to\-sale velocity across channels. * **Elevate the seller experience.** Make it effortless for sellers to understand their options, price their items accurately, and complete a sale via the PSA Partner Offer or eBay Consignment channel with Translate strategy into clear technical plans, specs, and user stories. Coordinate delivery across dedicated and partner engineering teams, and keep stakeholders aligned and projects moving. * **Connect the ecosystem.** Ensure seamless liquidity handoffs across the broader PSA enterprise, from Grading to Collection Management to Vaulting, reducing friction and resolving cross\-system dependencies that span payments, logistics, and risk. * **Communicate with clarity at every level.** From executive reviews to engineering standups, synthesize complexity, articulate tradeoffs, and bring people with you — clearly, in writing and in person. **Who You Are** --------------- * **6\+ years engineering experience.** You have a track record of designing, shipping, and scaling products 0\-to\-1 that have measurable business impact. Ideally 2\+ years operating as a Senior IC or equivalent technical leadership level at a high\-growth company or a scaled consumer platform. * **Full\-stack range.** You have strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and equally comfortable in modern frontend frameworks like React and Svelte, moving fluidly across the stack. Mobile experience using Flutter/Dart is a plus. * **Distributed\-systems depth.** You've designed and operated microservices and Kafka\-based event\-driven architectures, run workloads on Kubernetes, and know your way around the AWS ecosystem. * **Observability\-first mindset.** You instrument what you ship using tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or OpenTelemetry. You're comfortable building dashboards, setting up monitoring/alerting, and using distributed tracing to debug production issues. * **AI\-first engineer.** You build with AI tooling across the SDLC \- from planning and code generation to review and debugging. You lean on your experience to make high\-conviction calls quickly. * **Systems thinker and customer focused.** You naturally decompose complex, multi\-service systems into clean boundaries and intuitive interfaces, without losing sight of the customer experience. * **Influential communicator.** A strong written and verbal communicator who aligns engineers, product partners, and stakeholders without direct authority, makes crisp calls, and brings people with you. * **Bias for ownership.** You have an extreme ownership mindset and will wear any hat required to get the job done. You thrive in a fast\-moving, self\-directed environment — you set the bar, hold it, and take full accountability for outcomes. * **Passion for collecting** is a plus. Collectors uses e\-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States. We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e\-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business\-related equipment. If you suspect fraud, please reach out to interviewfraud@collectors.com. *We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We believe that a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills will better service the diverse community of collectors we support.* *If you require an accommodation to apply or interview with us due to a disability or special need, please email* *interviewaccommodation@collectors.com* *U.S. residents: for disclosures relating to personal information we collect during the employment application and recruitment process, please see our* *Privacy Notice for U.S. Applicants* *.*

been built. **Required Qualifications** Candidates should meet the following requirements: * Professional, hands\-on **C\#/.NET software development experience** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building applications, APIs, integrations, or enterprise systems * Experience working **directly with clients or business stakeholders** to understand business problems and and willingness to work onsite in Houston at least **2 days per week**, including at client locations as needed * Currently located in the **Greater Houston area** * Authorized to work in the United Preferred Qualifications * Experience with **OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other foundation models**. * Experience building **RAG\-based applications** using embeddings and vector databases. * Experience with vector databases such as **Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, OpenSearch, or pgvector**. * Experience with frameworks such as **LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel**. * Experience developing AI agents and tool\-using LLM applications. * Experience with ML frameworks such as **PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn**. * Experience with model evaluation, fine\-tuning, or parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning. * Familiarity with **MLOps/LLMOps** practices. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native application development. * Knowledge of AI security, data privacy, responsible AI, and model safety practices. * Experience designing highly scalable distributed systems. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Mechanical Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! **Job Description:** ==================== The Systems Engineer works as part of a multi\-disciplinary team to undertake custom industrial refrigeration and gas compression system equipment design \- performing calculations, making component selections, and building documentation for our customers according to requirements of their project. The engineer supports the delivery of project related engineering results and is responsible for the work they're assigned by the Project Engineer. Success in this position requires the candidate to work efficiently in both a collaborative and independent environment, be safety conscious, have good interpersonal skills with both internal and external customers, pay high attention to details, and have a strong motivation for delivering objectives. **As A Systems Engineer, You Will:** ==================================== * Review and interpret codes and standards (ASME, CRN, NFPA, AWS, IBC, etc.) for system compliance. * Make system component selections while generating a project Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P\&ID). Confer with Mechanical Design Engineers on standard products included in the project. * Conduct all necessary calculations, design reviews with production, and develop all custom documentation required for project execution. * Review and approve production drawings for custom systems, adding recommendations to improve design, reduce costs, or increase production efficiency. Chip in as a technical resource to the shop, customers, sales, and other departments to address and resolve questions and problems. * Prepare specifications for custom equipment and work with procurement to obtain quotations. * Participate in multi\-functional teams to address new design issues and resolve problems to ensure the continuous, ongoing improvement of processes and methods. **Required Education, Experience and Skills:** ============================================== * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant field with 1\+ years of engineering experience. Ability to understand and address a wide variety of technical problems with little mentorship. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely in writing and other presentation formats. Working experience with AutoCAD or similar 2D CAD software. * Must be an outstanding teammate, willing to learn from experienced staff and capable of introducing positive changes. Ability to travel 5\-10%. * Legal work authorization in the United States \- Sponsorship will not be provided for this role **Preferred Education, Experience \& Skills:** ============================================== * Previous experience with Compression systems or other pressure piping systems. Experience with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&ID). * Understanding of manufacturing BOM structure and ERP. * Previous experience in heat transfer products or thermodynamic systems. * Ability to coordinate and lead teams with varied strengths to implement changes and improvements. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-KC2 **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal \- to make the world a better place. We invest in the end\-to\-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland. **Work Authorization** Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. jobs.title: Senior Process Engineer
jobs.description: **Date:** Sep 25, 2026 **Location:** Winston\-Salem, NC, US, 27107 Winston\-Salem, NC, US, 27107 Winston\-Salem, NC, US, 27107 **Company:** Corning Requisition Number: 78238 **The company built on breakthroughs.** **Join us.** Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry\-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical\-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical\-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use. **Role Purpose** ---------------- The Senior Process Engineer is a Technical leadership role responsible for leading development, optimization, and designing sustainable manufacturing processes across optical fiber and cable production operations. This leadership role focuses on improving process capability, product quality, yield, throughput, material utilization, and overall operational efficiency while ensuring strict adherence to safety, and quality. The position serves as a technical authority within assigned process areas and plays a key role in driving continuous improvement, supporting new products, process, and equipment introductions. This role also takes management ownership of multiple junior or mid\-level engineers for mentoring, guiding, advising, and coaching. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead new product introductions, material trials, and process development activities from pilot through full production scale up. • Lead and execute end to end process optimization initiatives in a fiber optic cable manufacturing plant. • Lead a group of junior to mid\-level engineers for mentoring, guiding, advising, and coaching. • Collaborate with vendors’ technical team(s) to design, improve mechanical designs of new equipment involving automation. • Lead equipment design, integration, debug, improvement, and qualification. • Analyze manufacturing parameters to improve yield and process capability. • Lead documentation and change management for new equipment • Lead mechanistic understanding of manufacturing and equipment\-related issues using structured root cause analysis methodologies. * Provide technical leadership, training, and mentorship to junior engineers, technicians, and operators; serve as subject matter expert for assigned process areas. • Partner with Quality to resolve non conformances, customer complaints, and internal quality issues through corrective and preventive actions. • Collaborate closely with Production, Maintenance, R\&D, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams to improve reliability, process capability, and manufacturability. • Lead cross functional improvement projects and influence technical and manufacturing decisions. **Working Conditions/Travel Requirements/Hours of work** • This position is based in a manufacturing environment with regular floor presence and requires adherence to PPE and safety procedures. • Extended hours or travel may be necessary during critical production, troubleshooting, supplier, or benchmarking • Up to 25% to various manufacturing sites in the division • 8\-10 hours/day; 40\-50 hours/week. • Because this is a senior level role, complete ownership of tasks, projects will be expected; occasional after\-hours and weekend activities may be required. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Automation, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline. • 5\+ years of experience in process engineering within optical fiber, telecom cable, demonstrating strong knowledge of cable manufacturing processes, polymer extrusion technologies, material behavior, and process control systems. • 3\+ years of demonstrated management experience in leading team of junior or mid\-level engineers within cross functional teams; addressing new process development, process improvement, cost saving initiatives, talent development, and mentoring and influencing technical and manufacturing decisions. * 2\+ years experience with leading teams in any of the following: equipment design, automation, robotics, PLC’s, HMI’s, servo motors, process improvement, or material handling • 2\+ years of experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, SPC, FMEA, CAPA, 8D, and capability analysis tools focused on safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. • Leadership training certification (e.g., Dimension of Leadership, Dale Carnegie Training, advanced communication training, or military leadership training) • 2\+ year of experience Data analytics, (JMP preferred) **This position does not support immigration sponsorship.** The range for this position is $97,286\.00 \- $133,768\.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. **A job that shapes a life.** **Corning offers you the total package.** Your well\-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one. * Company\-wide bonuses and long\-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win. * As part of our commitment to your financial well\-being, we provide a 100% company\-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service. * Our health and well\-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company\-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family. * Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions. We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers requests for reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com. **Nearest Major Market:** Winston\-Salem

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced IT professional to oversee critical infrastructure engineering and deployment within the County of Santa Barbara’s Information Technology Department. Come and be a part of a team of talented individuals who are passionate about fostering a **culture of teamwork, learning and respect**! In the IT Department our success is powered by people and technology. Our culture is what makes IT a fun and rewarding place to work! We establish, develop and nurture partnerships and open communication within our communities. We embrace a willingness to learn and accept new ideas, to actively listen and to be receptive to change. We strive to grow our talents and do our best in the service of others while taking pride in our work. We explore and deliver new and creative ways to pair technology with business needs **The Service Operations Division** The Service Operations Division keeps the County’s technology foundation strong, secure, and always available. We organize our work around a proven operating model: Design, Build, Run. The systems we deliver are thoughtfully architected, expertly engineered, and reliably operated: * **Design \-** Our Systems Architect drives architecture, strategy, and modernization, setting the technical direction so that solutions are built to last. * **Build \-** Our engineering and deployment team turns approved designs into secure, production\-ready systems, the engineering, deployment, and delivery that bring modernization to life. * **Run \-** Our Infrastructure Operations team sustains what we deliver, providing the reliable, secure, and resilient operations the County depends on day in and day out. The Senior IT Systems Engineer sits at the heart of the **Build** function, translating architectural vision into the dependable infrastructure that County departments, and the communities they serve, rely on every day. **The Position** The Senior IT Systems Engineer is responsible for the engineering, implementation, and delivery of the County’s enterprise technology infrastructure. This role participates in the Build function within the Service Operations division and is responsible for translating approved architectural designs into secure, reliable, and supportable production systems. This role works on engineering and deployment activities across core infrastructure platforms including identity and directory services, Microsoft 365 services, endpoint and client computing environments, on\-premises and cloud server infrastructure, storage systems, backup and disaster recovery solutions, and Azure cloud services. The Senior IT Systems Engineer ensures solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational readiness expectations prior to transition to ongoing support. With guidance from the Engineering and Deployment Supervisor, this role partners closely with the Systems Architect (Design), Infrastructure Operations (Run), network and cybersecurity staff, application teams, vendors, and department stakeholders to deliver enterprise initiatives and modernization efforts on schedule and with high quality. We are currently recruiting to fill one full\-time vacancy. Remote work is permitted and this is a primarily remote role, but onsite work in Santa Barbara, CA is required when needed. Lodging/travel expenses are not provided. Employees of the County must primarily perform work in California. At this time, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must have permanent (not temporary) work authorization to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship by the start date of employment. jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Forward Deployed Engineer** -------------------------------------- **New York City · On\-site · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $180K–$250K base \+ competitive equity ### **About the Company** Our client is a well\-funded, seed\-stage AI company building the revenue execution platform for B2B enterprises. Their product pairs LLMs with structured customer data to tell post\-sales teams which accounts to prioritize, why, and what to do next, automating work that account management and customer success teams have long done by hand.
