jobs.title: Reservoir Engineer
jobs.description: **Excited to grow your career?** We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! *Our people make all the difference in our success.* Compensation Grade ONS\-USD\-35**Who We Are** **INEOS Energy** INEOS was founded in 1998 by Sir Jim Ratcliffe with a single site and has grown into one of the world's largest privately owned manufacturing groups. We have grown by buying good assets and running them better with small, empowered teams, minimal bureaucracy and a relentless focus on performance. INEOS Energy is building a global energy business, and our US Onshore team in Denver currently operates approximately 2,000 wells in the Eagle Ford shale play of South Texas. We are a small team with a big mandate: grow the business through disciplined development and acquisitions. **About the job** **Job Title: Subsurface Manager** **Department: Development** **Summary of Position** We are seeking a skilled and motivated Subsurface Manager to play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling our US onshore development program. This is a hands\-on role for a strong reservoir engineer who wants real ownership. This high\-impact position will lead and develop a small team while owning critical development tracking, capital budgeting, and reserves processes. You will drive accountability across active development pads, lead the capital forecast and capital budget submission process, oversee corporate reserves, and provide essential insight for lender, capital markets, and executive reporting. With significant visibility across the business and direct influence on investment decisions, you will help translate subsurface expertise into disciplined, value\-creating development plans. **What We Look For** * Uncompromising on safety. * An owner's mindset. You treat company capital like it's your own money. * A bias for action. You make sound decisions quickly with imperfect information, and you don't wait for permission. * Commercial instinct. You connect subsurface work to value: dollars, barrels and returns. * Hands\-on and unpretentious. You're happy to build the model yourself and to be in the field when it matters. * Drive and resilience. You thrive in a lean team where everyone carries real responsibility. **Primary Job Responsibilities** * Manage, coach, and develop a Reservoir Engineer and Senior Development Geoscientist, setting clear priorities and ensuring high\-quality technical analysis across development planning, capital allocation, and reserves. * Own development tracking and project accountability across active development pads, including permitting status, land clearance, and engineering milestones. Maintain the Pad Readiness tracking process, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and partner across functions to support on\-time execution. * Lead the monthly capital forecasting process, tracking actual spend against budget, identifying opportunities to reallocate or repurpose capital, and preparing and refining capital budget submissions for Finance. * Lead and perform economic evaluations and reservoir analyses, including decline curve analysis and type\-curve development, to inform development decisions, capital budgeting, and reserves. * Lead the corporate reserves process, including database management, Lease Operating Statement models, economic model runs, and documentation sufficient to support internal and external audits. * Support reserve\-based lending redeterminations and other capital markets activities by responding to lender and bank\-engineering inquiries, preparing Lease Operating Statement updates, and coordinating with third\-party reserve auditors and legal counsel to ensure reserve values and technical disclosures are accurate and well\-supported. * Develop clear, decision\-ready technical materials for ExCo approval packages, post\-investment pad lookbacks, and other internal and external stakeholder updates. * Champion compliance with safety and environmental requirements while promoting a strong culture of safety across all activities. Education \& Experience: * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Minimum of eight years of upstream oil and gas experience with an operator, including at least three years in reservoir engineering, asset development engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Strong technical expertise in reservoir analysis, development planning, economic evaluation, capital forecasting, and reserves processes. * Strong proficiency with ComboCurve, ARIES, reservoir modeling platforms, Spotfire, Power BI, and Microsoft Office. Familiarity with SQL, Python, or other data analytics tools is considered an asset. * Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build credibility across disciplines, translate complex technical analysis into clear recommendations, and influence decisions at all levels of the organization. * Demonstrated leadership capability through mentoring, collaboration, project leadership, or influencing multidisciplinary teams. Prior people\-management experience is welcomed but not required; we are equally open to a highly capable technical professional who is ready to step into their first formal leadership role. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work confidently with complex datasets, exercise sound judgment, and adapt to new challenges and technologies. * Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high standards of safety and environmental responsibility. **Travel \& Additional Requirements:** * Work Location: Work is performed at both field and office locations. * Schedule: 9/80 * Travel required to INEOS field locations. * INEOS is a drug free workplace. All offers to successful candidates will be subject to successful background check and drug screen. **Relocation:** This role is based in our Denver office; relocation assistance may be available. **Work Authorization:** INEOS USA Oil \& Gas LLC is not currently sponsoring employment visas for this position. **Compensation \& Benefits** Please note that the compensation information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (EPEWA) and Equal Pay Transparency Rules. It is estimated based on what a successful Colorado applicant might be paid. It assumes that the successful candidate will be in Colorado or perform the position from Colorado. Similar positions located outside of Colorado will not necessarily receive the same compensation. **Compensation:** The annual rate for this position generally ranges between $185,000 \- $235,000 with an opportunity for a company\-wide annual discretionary bonus, of up to 50% of eligible pay. This role, depending on skill level and experience, may also participate in the Long\-Term Incentive Plan with annual awards, vesting over three years. These ranges are estimates, based on potential employee qualifications, operational needs, business performance to metrics, and other considerations permitted by law. The range may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by Colorado Equal Pay Transparency Rule 4\.1\.2\. **Benefits:** Benefits package includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. INEOS also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle\-specific benefits. 401(k) retirement has both an automatic 6% company contribution and a match of up to an additional 6% of eligible compensation. We offer generous paid time off that includes both sick and vacation which is based on and increases, with industry experience. **Application Deadline:** Application Deadline: October 31, 2026\. **Notice To Third Party Agencies:** INEOS does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to INEOS in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where INEOS has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of INEOS and INEOS will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service. ### **Job Details** * Location Denver, CO, United States * Discipline Engineering * Type Full\-time * Business INEOS Energy * Posted 24 September 2026 * Requisition ID REQ\-2993

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** IPT Global is the pioneer and recognized global leader in digital well assurance, trusted by major operators and drilling contractors worldwide to deliver well schematics, advanced pressure testing technology, and equipment health monitoring with unmatched efficiency, reliability, and safety. For more than 16 years, IPT Global has set the standard for well lifecycle management, helping operators and drilling contractors reduce risk, protect personnel and the environment, and operate with greater confidence — completing more than 300,000 pressure tests across rig operations in over 25 countries. Our SureTec® platform brings well schematics, digital pressure testing, and equipment health monitoring together in a single connected ecosystem, transforming fragmented well data into actionable intelligence. Built collaboratively with the operators and drilling contractors who use it, SureTec delivers the right information to the right people at the right time, enabling faster decisions, stronger assurance, and safer operations across the well lifecycle. IPT Global also provides 24/7 real\-time monitoring and expert support, ensuring continuous surveillance and immediate assistance whenever and wherever it's needed. **Job Description** **Location:** Houston, TX **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Schedule:** Exempt **Travel:** Up to 75% — Offshore Gulf of Mexico and International About the Role: We are seeking a Field Engineer to support field operations at client work sites, including offshore and international locations. This role is responsible for coordinating well control equipment and well barrier testing operations, supporting equipment and network installations, troubleshooting field technology, and ensuring safe, high\-quality service delivery. The Field Engineer will work closely with clients, vendors, and internal teams to coordinate field activities, resolve issues, document testing processes, and identify opportunities to improve customer support. Key Responsibilities: * Serve as a visible safety leader at client work sites and participate in applicable work site and rig\-based safety programs. * Plan, coordinate, and manage well control equipment and well barrier testing operations. * Coordinate with clients, stakeholders, and other vendors to streamline testing operations. * Monitor and thoroughly document testing processes associated with surface and subsea operations. * Create Base Schematic Design (BSD) files, wellbore schematics, and test plans. * Plan, coordinate, and manage equipment and network installations in a variety of field environments. * Troubleshoot basic network and connectivity issues on offshore rigs and escalate issues to the Real\-Time Operations Center (RTOC) and Operations Manager when necessary. * Follow established processes and procedures to ensure consistent, high\-quality service delivery. * Develop an understanding of client needs and identify opportunities to enhance customer support. * Perform other duties as assigned. What We're Looking For: The successful candidate will be adaptable, technically capable, customer\-focused, and comfortable working in demanding field environments. Strong communication skills and a commitment to continuous learning are important, as the role requires working with clients, vendors, and internal teams across a variety of field situations. The ideal candidate demonstrates: * Strong verbal and written communication. * Customer service and relationship\-building skills. * Adaptability and the ability to manage competing priorities. * Attention to detail and a commitment to quality. * A willingness to learn and continuously develop technical expertise. * Resourcefulness and the ability to identify practical solutions in the field. * A strong commitment to safety and service excellence. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited university. * Ability and willingness to receive the yellow fever vaccination. * Ability to maintain all required safety and training certifications necessary to perform field responsibilities. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation, including nights, weekends, and extended hours. * Valid driver's license and proof of sufficient vehicle insurance. * Ability to successfully complete the company's field training program. * Ability to work offshore and travel by helicopter and boat. * Ability to obtain and maintain a Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC). * Ability to obtain and maintain HUET/BOSIET certification. * Valid U.S. passport or ability to obtain one. * Ability to pass required medical examinations for offshore work. * Willingness and ability to travel on short notice to locations throughout the world for extended periods. * Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF creation, and other proprietary software. * Computer troubleshooting, networking/network troubleshooting, and hardware repair skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in the oil and gas industry. * Knowledge of drilling, completions, intervention, and plug and abandonment (P\&A) operations. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Skidding/E-House Engineering Manager
jobs.description: At IEM, we're not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we're shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world\-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what's possible. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting out, you'll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world's most dynamic markets. **Location:** San Antonio, TX **Reports To:** VP of Design Engineering **Position Summary:** The **Skidding/E\-House Engineering Manager** leads the structural engineering discipline supporting the design and fabrication of skid\-mounted equipment packages and electrical houses (E\-Houses). This role is the primary technical authority for IBC code compliance, state licensing, state certifications/inspections, PE stamping, and lift calculations, and manages a team of engineers to ensure all skid and E\-House structural designs are safe, code\-compliant, and delivered on schedule. This position reports directly to the VP of Engineering. **Key Responsibilities:** * Serve as the primary technical authority on International Building Code (IBC) compliance for all skid\-mounted equipment packages and electrical house (E\-House) structural designs. * Review, approve, and PE\-stamp structural calculations, drawings, and specifications for skids and E\-Houses in accordance with applicable codes and state requirements. * Perform and oversee lift calculations and rigging plans to ensure the safe lifting, transport, and installation of skids and E\-Houses. * Manage state professional licensing for the engineering group, ensuring the team holds and maintains the licenses required in every state where projects are executed. * Coordinate state certifications, inspections, and permitting activities for skid and E\-House projects, acting as the primary liaison with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and third\-party inspectors. * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of structural and design engineers supporting skidding and E\-House programs. * Partner with the VP of Engineering to establish structural engineering standards, design practices, and quality control processes for skids and E\-Houses. * Review project scopes and customer specifications early in the proposal and design phases to identify structural, code, and licensing requirements. * Collaborate with project management, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure structural designs are manufacturable, code\-compliant, and delivered on schedule. * Evaluate site\-specific loading conditions (seismic, wind, snow, transportation) and ensure designs are engineered accordingly. * Support proposal and estimating efforts with structural engineering scope reviews, risk assessments, and man\-hour estimates. * Stay current on changes to the IBC, state building codes, and state licensing/certification requirements, and update internal engineering standards accordingly. * Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for structural or code\-compliance issues identified during design, fabrication, or in the field. **Competencies:** * In\-depth knowledge of the International Building Code (IBC) and applicable state/local building codes as they apply to the structural design of skids and E\-Houses. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license, with demonstrated ability to stamp structural calculations and drawings. * Working knowledge of state licensing, certification, and inspection processes for structural equipment and prefabricated structures. * Proficiency in performing and reviewing lift calculations and rigging/transportation plans. * Strong background in structural analysis and design, including relevant structural design software. * Leadership and people\-management skills, with the ability to build, mentor, and develop an engineering team. * Task management and the ability to carry a plan to completion across a number of concurrent projects. * Excellent written and oral communication skills. * Ability to interact directly with customers, sales, inspectors, other technical resources, and management. * Technical writing skills. * Organization skills. * Excellent working knowledge of MS Office Suites (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, etc.). * Pride in workmanship. * Manages multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal supervision; demonstrates consistent prioritization and planning. * Attention to detail and thoroughness. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Structural, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. * 15\+ years of structural engineering experience within the skidding/E\-House industry. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license required; ability to obtain licensure/reciprocity in additional states as needed. * Demonstrated experience with IBC compliance, state licensing, state certifications/inspections, PE stamping, and lift calculations. * Prior experience managing or leading an engineering team preferred. * Experience working directly with customers, third\-party inspectors, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) preferred. **Why Join IEM** At IEM, you'll join a team that powers some of the world's most ambitious projects. jobs.title: Uipath developer (RPA & Agentic AI)
jobs.description: Job Description * The UiPath Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions that improve operational efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and citizen service delivery across agencies. This role supports both traditional linear automation workflows and emerging Agentic AI solutions using UiPath’s automation platform. **Key Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and implement UiPath automation solutions for business processes. * Build and maintain automations including attended, unattended, and scheduled bots for repetitive, rules\-based workflows. * Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable automation solutions using UiPath Studio, UiPath Studio Web, Orchestrator, and related technologies. * Develop process workflows, exception handling, logging, auditing, and monitoring capabilities for enterprise\-grade automation. * Create reusable automation components, libraries, \& templates to support enterprise automation initiatives. * Support integration of UiPath solutions with government systems, databases, APIs, document management systems, and cloud services. * Implement secure automation practices aligned with cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance standards. * Perform testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance of automation solutions. * Monitor bot performance, resolve production issues, and optimize automation reliability and efficiency. * Develop technical documentation and workflow diagrams. * Support citizen service modernization initiatives through intelligent automation technologies. **Agentic AI Responsibilities** * Design and implement Agentic AI solutions using UiPath Autopilot, AI Center, Document Understanding, Communications Mining, and generative AI capabilities. * Develop AI\-powered agents capable of autonomous decision\-making, contextual reasoning, and multi\-step task orchestration within defined governance controls. * Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), AI services, and intelligent document processing into automation workflows. * Build human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that combine AI agents with employee oversight and approval processes. * Develop intelligent agents capable of interpreting unstructured data, emails, forms, documents, and citizen communications. * Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and AI orchestration techniques within UiPath ecosystems. * Ensure responsible AI practices including transparency, auditability, bias mitigation, security, and compliance with government policies. * Evaluate emerging AI and automation technologies to improve operational efficiency and service delivery. * Assist with establishing enterprise standards and governance for Agentic AI implementations across agencies. **Preferred Technical Skills** * UiPath Studio, StudioX, Orchestrator, AI Center, Action Center, and Document Understanding * REFramework and enterprise RPA design patterns * API integrations, REST/SOAP services, SQL databases * OCR technologies and intelligent document processing * Generative AI, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and AI orchestration * Programming/scripting languages such as C\#, VB.NET, Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript * Cloud platforms and enterprise authentication/security concepts * Agile/Scrum development methodologies

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer
jobs.description: **A Little About Inn\-Flow** At Inn\-Flow, we’re more than a hotel software company \- we’re a team on a mission to transform how the hospitality industry operates. Built by hoteliers, for hoteliers, our all\-in\-one back\-office platform brings together accounting, labor management, payroll, business intelligence, and more into one seamless experience. Our technology empowers hotel operators to work smarter, make better decisions, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional guest experiences. Inn\-Flow is experiencing strong growth and momentum, backed by the strategic investment from Mainsail Partners. As we scale, we’re expanding the leadership team, accelerating innovation, and deepening our impact across the hospitality industry, all while staying grounded in the real needs of operators. Our commitment to both customers outcomes and employee experience has earned industry recognition, including multiple top honors from the 2026 HotelTechAwards and recognition as a Top 10 Best Places to Work in Hotel Tech and Triangle Business Journal’s \#2 Best Place to Work. At Inn\-Flow, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career, and be part of a company that’s shaping the future of hospitality technology. **About the Role** We are seeking an Application Support Engineer with strong SQL Server experience to provide Level 3 support for business\-critical applications. This role focuses on advanced troubleshooting of production issues, analyzing and optimizing existing SQL objects, and ensuring system stability and performance. The position is primarily backend\-focused, with occasional direct interaction with customers to support issue resolution. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide **Level 3 application support** for enterprise systems * Lead investigation and resolution of complex production issues * Analyze and optimize existing SQL queries, stored procedures, and indexes * Perform controlled data validation and corrections in SQL Server * Diagnose issues across the full application stack — SQL Server, .NET, and React * Monitor application and database performance and drive root cause analysis * Partner with development teams on defect resolution and long\-term fixes * Occasionally engage with customers to clarify issues and communicate resolutions * Document root causes, permanent fixes, and support procedures **Required Qualifications** * **3\+ years of experience** in application or production support, including Level 3 responsibilities * Strong hands\-on experience with **Microsoft SQL Server** * **Advanced SQL** troubleshooting and performance tuning skills * Experience reviewing execution plans and optimizing existing database objects * Exposure to **.NET and React** applications, with the ability to read code, trace stack traces/logs, and isolate issues. * Strong understanding of application architecture, data flows, and integrations * Proven ability to independently resolve complex technical issues * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills **Preferred** * Experience supporting enterprise or SaaS applications * Familiarity with Azure environments * Experience with New Relic or similar application performance monitoring tools * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot **Why You'll Love Working at Inn\-Flow** We believe great work starts with taking great care of our people. At Inn\-Flow, you’ll enjoy: **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Short\-Term Disability \& Life Insurance * 401(k) with a generous employer match **Time Off \& Flexibility** * Flexible vacation and PTO * Paid holidays plus a floating holiday * Paid volunteer time * Hybrid work schedule with in\-office collaboration on Tuesdays and Thursdays in our Raleigh office (remote Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays) **Work Environment \& Culture** * A beautiful, modern office in downtown Raleigh * Employer\-paid monthly parking * Monthly team socials and regular celebrations * Quarterly all\-hands meetings * A culture rooted in recognition, collaboration, and growth * Smart, kind, and genuinely fun people who care about their work \- and each other **Equal Opportunity Employer** Inn\-Flow is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, upholding a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. We make our hiring decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, family status, or any other non\-business consideration. We stand firmly against discrimination and harassment in any form.

jobs.title: Systems Technician
jobs.description: **Are you ready to shape the future of IT? Join Integris, where integrity meets innovation, and people come first.** At Integris, we don’t just offer jobs, we offer purpose. As a nationally recognized **Best Places to Work** and a leader in **future\-ready managed services**, we’re redefining how businesses experience IT. Our mission is bold: to empower clients and employees alike through secure, strategic, and scalable technology solutions. We’re looking for talent that thrives in a culture of **clarity, trust, and relentless execution**, individuals who believe that IT is not just support, but a strategic advantage. If you’re passionate about innovation, driven by impact, and ready to grow with a company that puts **People First**, you’ll find your place here. **Job Summary:** The Systems Technician is responsible for providing frontline technical support for single end\-user level issues, including personal computer, printer, Microsoft 365, Windows application, mobile device, and basic connectivity matters. This role serves as the initial point of contact for client technical assistance and is responsible for managing inquiries received through phone, email, and the client portal. The Systems Technician provides exceptional customer service while troubleshooting and resolving support requests efficiently and effectively. This position may execute responsibilities from the service desk, the field, a client site, an Integris office, or a remote home office depending on business and client needs. This role is expected to build technical capability over time, follow documented processes, maintain accurate service ticket documentation, and escalate complex technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers when appropriate. The Systems Technician contributes to a positive client experience and plays an important role in maintaining daily service delivery operations. **Job Responsibilities:** *Ticket Management* * Work assigned tickets in order of SLA. * Serve as the first point of contact for client support requests received through phone, email, and client portal. * Answer inbound support calls, create service tickets, and ensure requests are properly documented, categorized, and prioritized. * Troubleshoot and resolve frontline technical issues efficiently and effectively to minimize disruption to customer operations. * Escalate advanced or unresolved technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers following established escalation procedures. * Document all technical work comprehensively to facilitate accurate client billing and ongoing support. *Collaboration, Communication, and Customer Service* * Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with a focus on professionalism, responsiveness, and problem\-solving. * Communicate clearly with clients regarding ticket status, troubleshooting steps, next steps, and resolution details. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other technical team members to resolve client issues. * Participate in team meetings, training sessions, documentation efforts, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Follow up with clients and internal team members as needed to support timely issue resolution and a positive client experience. *Technical Support* *\& Documentation* * Provide frontline technical support for end\-user devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and common infrastructure issues, escalating complex issues as appropriate. * Support the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of workstations, peripheral devices, and basic server, networking, and cloud technologies under established procedures. * Assist with Microsoft 365 user administration, including account provisioning, password resets, licensing, and basic support for Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint. * Troubleshoot common connectivity issues involving workstations, printers, wireless networks, VPN access, and basic network services, escalating advanced networking issues when necessary. * Support backup verification, endpoint management, documentation, ticketing, remote management, and monitoring tools as part of daily operational activities. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other team members to resolve client issues while continuing to develop technical knowledge and skills. * Follow established IT service management processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to deliver consistent, high\-quality support. * Maintain accurate documentation of work performed and contribute to knowledge base articles and SOP updates as appropriate. *Professional Development \& Technical Growth* * Demonstrate curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Microsoft technologies, networking fundamentals, service delivery, and client support. * Participate in training, coaching, and certification pathways that support continued growth into advanced technical responsibilities. * Leverage approved AI solutions responsibly to accelerate learning, improve troubleshooting efficiency, enhance documentation quality, and support better customer outcomes. * Develop foundational technical knowledge that prepares the employee for potential progression into Systems Administrator responsibilities. **Job Qualifications** *Education/Certification Requirements:* * Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). * Valid driver’s license. * Entry\-level certifications are preferred. Examples including but not limited to: + CompTIA A\+ + Google IT Support Professional Certificate + Microsoft Fundamentals certifications + CompTIA Network\+ *Experience Requirements:* * 1\-3 years of experience in technical support, help desk, desktop support, call center technical support, field support, or related IT support roles. * Experience supporting Microsoft operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, basic networking issues, and end\-user technology. * Experience delivering customer\-facing support with a strong focus on professionalism, communication, and service quality. * Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP), consulting, or multi\-client IT support environment is preferred. *Technical Knowledge \& Experience (including, but not limited to):* * Administration and troubleshooting of Windows workstation environments. * Basic Microsoft 365 administration and end\-user support. * Basic Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID user administration. * Basic understanding of Azure cloud concepts and Microsoft cloud services. * Basic networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, wireless connectivity, and general connectivity troubleshooting. * Experience using ticketing systems and remote support tools, including ConnectWise or similar platforms. * Familiarity with endpoint management and remote monitoring tools, including Intune, ConnectWise Automate, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with firewall, wireless, and network support tools, including WatchGuard, Meraki, or similar technologies. * Working knowledge of hardware, printers, mobile devices, peripherals, and workstation deployment. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, user security awareness, data privacy, and appropriate handling of client information. * Working knowledge of AI\-assisted productivity and support tools, including Microsoft Copilot, Chat GPT Enterprise, and other approved generative AI solutions. * Ability to leverage AI tools responsibly to improve troubleshooting efficiency, documentation quality, and customer support outcomes. At **Integris**, we value our team members and **offer comprehensive benefits**, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401K Retirement Plan * Minimum 4 Weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) * Birthday PTO * Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off for Volunteering * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Life Insurance * Supplemental Insurance * Employee Assistance Program Join us in transforming IT services for small and midsize businesses across regulated industries. Be part of a team that’s scaling nationally, investing in vertical expertise, and **building for better**. *Integris is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, familial status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected class under applicable federal, state, and local laws.* *\#LI\-Hybrid*

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description: This role will drive a next\-generation industrial IoT and edge computing platform to power intelligent material handling systems operating in demanding, real\-time environments. This platform will span ARM and x86 architectures, integrate containerized applications via Docker, and support a real\-time operating system (RTOS) to enable deterministic control alongside higher\-level analytics and orchestration. We are seeking a Solution Architect to define and own the system architecture end\-to\-end—bridging embedded systems, real\-time control, cloud\-connected edge platforms, and modern DevOps practices. This role will be instrumental in shaping the technology foundation for future products and scaling the platform across multiple industrial applications. Intralox is a division of Laitram, L.L.C., with an extensive portfolio of innovative conveyance solutions and services that improve lives and optimize businesses worldwide. Our global workforce of over 3,000 employees in 20\+ countries consist of reliable problem solvers, continuously developing and directly delivering solutions that have driven our customers’ growth worldwide for more than 50 years. Intralox was founded on the principle of doing the right thing, by treating customers, employees, and suppliers with honesty, fairness, and respect. We invest heavily in these values and aim to practice our business philosophy principles every day, which is why we have been consistently recognized for innovation and workplace excellence. We believe in the power of a good idea no matter where it comes from, using trust as the foundation to how we work, and that self\-managed people are our greatest asset. We listen objectively, think creatively, and deliver results. To learn more about our company culture, philosophy, and benefits, please visit our company page. **This position is not eligible for work authorization or sponsorship.** **Responsibilities:** *System \& Platform Architecture** Architect a heterogeneous edge platform supporting both ARM and x86 compute targets. * Define system\-level designs that integrate: o RTOS\-based deterministic control o Embedded Linux and containerized workloads o Secure connectivity to enterprise and cloud systems o Integrate parametric AI workflows for local and remote data disposition* Establish architectural principles for scalability, fault tolerance, and industrial lifecycle support. *Real\-Time \& Embedded Integration** Design hybrid architectures where RTOS\-based control loops coexist with Linux\-based edge services. * Define inter\-process and inter\-OS communication strategies (shared memory, IPC, DDS, gRPC, etc.). * Ensure deterministic timing, safety, and performance constraints are met under all operating conditions. *Containerization \& Deployment** Lead the architectural approach for Docker\-based application deployment at the edge. * Define container orchestration strategies appropriate for resource\-constrained, industrial environments. * Partner with DevOps and firmware teams to shape CI/CD pipelines for embedded and edge systems. *Security, Reliability \& Compliance** Architect secure boot, device identity, and software update strategies. * Define approaches for OTA updates across RTOS, firmware, and containerized applications. * Incorporate cybersecurity best practices and industrial compliance standards from day one. Familiarity with IEC 62443 preferred. *Cross\-Functional Leadership** Serve as the technical authority across engineering, product management, and operations. * Translate product requirements into platform capabilities and technical roadmaps. * Mentor engineers and influence architectural decisions without direct authority. **Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or other related field. * 5\+ years of experience in systems architecture, embedded platforms, or edge computing. * Strong hands\-on experience with ARM and x86 architectures. * Proven expertise in at least one RTOS (e.g., QNX, VxWorks, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, RTLinux). * Deep understanding of Linux\-based embedded systems. * Experience designing and deploying Docker/containerized applications on edge devices. * Strong grasp of networking, protocols, and industrial communication patterns. * Ability to operate at both high\-level architecture and low\-level technical detail. * Ability to travel up to 25% **Preferred Qualifications:*** Master's degree * Experience in industrial automation, robotics, material handling, or controls systems. * Familiarity with functional safety concepts (ISO 13849, IEC 61508, etc.). * Experience with edge orchestration, fleet management, or IoT platforms. * Strong documentation skills, including architecture diagrams and design specifications. * Prior experience acting as a technical lead or principal architect. **What Sets This Role Apart:*** Greenfield platform with real architectural ownership * Opportunity to influence hardware, firmware, and software together * Balance of hard real\-time control and modern cloud\-native practices * High\-visibility role shaping a strategic product line Intralox’s benefit program is a major part of an employee’s total compensation from the company. Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits including health, dental, vision, and disability insurance, paid time off, 401K, flexible spending account, life and AD\&D insurance, long term care, tuition reimbursement, and additional voluntary benefits. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Intralox considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training and key skills. Engineering teams. * Enhance efficiency of patching and maintenance operations through structured scheduling, automation opportunities, and consistent communication practices. * Leverage metrics—such technical risk, complexity, and business impact. **Core Technical Expertise** **Cloud \& Kubernetes** * Expertise supporting and troubleshooting Microsoft Azure, including AKS, VNets, NSGs, Load jobs.title: Principal Engineer (AI, Office of the CEO)
jobs.description: **Do you want to be the first engineer on something an entire company will run on?** Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a **Principal Software Engineer, AI,** to join the **Office of the CEO**. **The team:** This is a startup inside Jobber. A small, senior team in the Office of the CEO with a mandate to reinvent how a 1,000\-person company operates in the AI era, and the backing to actually do it. No layers between you and the decision\-makers, no roadmap theater, no waiting for alignment. We ship something real every few hours, learn from it, and compound. The work touches every function at Jobber, and what we build becomes how the company thinks and moves. **The role:** Reporting to the **VP of Customer Experience Innovation**, the Principal Software Engineer will be the founding technical seat: you'll architect and build new AI systems from zero to production, and own the hard problems that come with putting AI at the center of how a company runs — trust, permissions, security, and quality at scale. This is a builder's role with unusual range. One week you're designing the architecture of a system nobody at Jobber has built before; the next you're embedded with a team, shipping working AI into their real workflow and making them the hero. You'll make fast build\-vs\-buy calls, run POCs and kill them without sentiment, and set the technical standards that everything AI at Jobber gets held to. We're looking for someone who has shipped production AI or data systems, defaults to pragmatic technology choices, and wants founding\-engineer ownership with a real company's resources behind it. The **Principal Software Engineer, AI** will: * Architect and build new internal AI systems end to end, from first design to production, as the founding engineer. * Own the hard parts of trustworthy AI at company scale: retrieval quality, permissions, security, and reliability. * Work hands\-on across the modern AI stack (LLMs, retrieval, agents, integrations) while keeping the foundations deliberately pragmatic. * Embed with teams across the company, working day\-to\-day with function leaders and their teams and weekly with executive leadership, shipping AI into real workflows and leaving behind systems and owners that outlast the visit. * Drive build\-vs\-buy evaluations and fast POCs, with the judgment to commit hard and kill fast. * Work directly with executive leadership: what you build informs how the company makes decisions, every day. **To be successful, you should have:** * A track record of building production systems at Staff\+ scope: data infrastructure, retrieval, or applied AI used daily by hundreds to thousands of people who depend on it. * Hands\-on depth with the modern AI stack, and at least one battle scar from a system that showed you how confidently AI can be wrong. * Pragmatic technology instincts: you reach for proven tools by default and can defend the exceptions. * Founding\-engineer, consulting, or forward\-deployed experience: comfortable owning outcomes inside someone else's domain. * A daily working relationship with AI tools and agents, as instruments you build with and build for. * The pragmatism to ship every few weeks, the standards to make it trustworthy anyway, and the communication skills to explain both to a CEO. **Compensation:** At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $229,300, a midpoint of $269,700, and a maximum salary of $310,200, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long\-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process! **What you can expect from Jobber:** * A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options. * A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential. * A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400\-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet. * To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh\*t about our customers. *We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.* **A bit more about us:** Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

This role is critical to ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of critical systems, with a strong emphasis on data center infrastructure, power/energy management, and industrial automation. This role will involve designing and developing wiring harness systems, including schematic creation, harness architecture, panel layout, developing specifications, selecting key components, and transitioning design to manufacturing. Furthermore, the position includes leading test process implementation and ensuring equipment alignment to maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and reliability. * Requires up to 25% domestic and/or international travel **What will you do?** * Define and own the control system architecture across multiple platforms, including PLCs, BMS, EPMS, and ATS systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Develop detailed control system specifications, functional design documents, and interface definitions for all subsystems. * Proficiency in PLC/SCADA programming, HMI development, and system integration with IT networks and facility equipment. * Ability to read and create BOMs. visual aids, electrical schematics, control diagrams, and sequence of operations. * Define control logic, sensor integration, and communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, BACnet, SNMP) for intelligent power and cooling management. * Validate control systems through simulation, testing, and commissioning to ensure reliability, safety, and responsiveness. * Experience with critical infrastructure systems: UPS, generators, switchgear, chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, fire suppression systems. * Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new projects and revisions. * Drive the development of system\-level simulations and digital twins to validate control strategies before deployment * Architect integration strategies for control systems with enterprise platforms such as SCADA, CMMS, and cloud\-based monitoring tools * Establish design patterns and best practices for modular and reusable control logic across projects * Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex control system issues during commissioning and operations * Evaluate emerging technologies and automation trends to continuously improve system performance and efficiency * Develop and maintain documentation for system architecture, control logic, and operational procedures * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, software, and facilities engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of control systems with physical infrastructure * Work closely with cross functional teams to align control system designs with business requirements, timelines, and operational constraints * Facilitate design reviews, technical workshops, and cross\-functional planning sessions to ensure alignment and transparency across engineering disciplines Support commissioning and field teams during deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization of control systems * **How will you get here?** Education : Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline. * Experience : * 8\+ years pf experience in control system design and implementation * Deep expertise in the following: + PLC programming (Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider Electric) + Building Management Systems (BMS) integration and optimization + Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS/EDPM) for real\-time energy analytics + Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) control and failover logic * Strong proficiency in control theory, system modeling, and simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink) * Experience with industrial protocols (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP) Familiarity with NFPA, IEC, and ISO standards related to control systems and safety. * **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:** * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills * Creative, self\-motivated, accountable, and team\-oriented * Able to work independently with minimal oversight as part of a global team * Proficient in reading, analyzing, and interpreting general business publications, professional journals, technical procedures, and gover itchgear, switch panels, busways, ATS units, EDPM, BMS systems, and control panels, as well as cooling solutions ranging from traditional evaporative and indirect cooling systems to emerging liquid cooling technologies including chillers, heat exchangers, CDUs, pumps, and secondary fluid networks. This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H\-1B, PERM). **What you'll be responsible for:*** Performs and leads system analysis and programming activities that take AI proofs of concept to production\-ready software — including the research needed where no established pattern exists yet, and timely, quality delivery into production. * Performs, and may lead, technical/engineering support for new and existing applications from code delivery until the retirement of the application. * Develops, tests and reviews applications based on business requirements and industry best practices. Uses best practices, standard guidance, and agentic development workflows to create and modify code. * Considers how code changes will affect end users and internal teams. * Reviews code created by less experienced team members. * Collaborates with quality and security partners — cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and AI governance — to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality products. * Performs and may lead work with cross\-team as projects dictate. * Works on and leads critical tasks and deliverables with no assistance, and sets and updates expectations on size, scope, and timelines. * Participates in and may lead team in cross\-functional meetings and discussions. * Creates required technical documentation. * Stays updated with emerging AI technologies and industry trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve software development processes. * Adheres to documented departmental and corporate standards. * Participates in the definition and documentation of standards — including what "production\-ready" means for AI systems at Jack Henry. * Lead unit tests, integration tests, and evals to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of developed software, especially AI systems and workflows. * Debugs and troubleshoots issues as they arise, providing timely resolutions — including failure modes specific to AI systems, like quality drift, prompt regressions, provider outages, and cost spikes. * May contribute to product architecture. * May Perform other duties as assigned. **What you'll need to have:*** Must have a minimum of 6 years of technical experience in software development. * Production ownership of AI systems (AI agents, AI features in products, MCP servers, etc). * Experience with a major cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure). * Experience with unit testing and end\-to\-end automated testing. * Experience with Kubernetes. * Experience with any of the following: Large language models (LLM), vector databases. * Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities. * Must be self\-directed, and willing to push through roadblocks rather than wait them out. * Must be able to travel up to 10% to attend internal business meetings, training and/or professional conferences. **What would be nice for you to have:*** Bachelor’s degree. * Fintech experience. * Experience with GCP and infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Experience in cloud security and DevOps. * Experience with model fine\-tuning, evaluation (e.g. controlling for bias), and validation. * Experience with AI observability, evals, and model monitoring. Tools, Sustainment Management Planning, Integrated Reliability and Maintainability (R\&M) Test Planning, and Affordability and Life Cycle Cost Analysis. * The employee will author test plans and Technologies \& Platforms * Power BI * Azure Databricks * Azure Data Lake * Azure Data Factory * SQL Server * Snowflake Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment. * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. jobs.title: Data & AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **Your Job** Koch Technology Data Solutions (KTDS) is seeking a Data \& AI Solutions Architect to shape the future of data, analytics, automation, and AI across Koch. In this role, you will partner with business leaders, engineers, product teams, and subject matter experts to solve complex business challenges. You will translate business outcomes into scalable solutions, guide technology decisions, establish reusable patterns, and accelerate delivery through modern Data \& AI architectures. The ideal candidate is an AI\-native architect who uses AI as both a solution capability and a core part of how they work. You rapidly explore options, validate ideas through prototypes, and determine where AI, automation, software, data products, or process improvements create the greatest value. **Our Team** KT Data Solutions builds and operates reusable data, analytics, and AI capabilities that help teams make better decisions, automate work, and unlock new opportunities across Koch. We operate in a data\-centric way\-treating trusted, governed, and reusable data products as shared enterprise assets that provide the context for analytics, automation, and AI. Our vision is to compound value through trusted data, reusable platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions that scale across the enterprise. **Location: This role can be located in Wichita, KS / Atlanta, GA / Plano, TX and requires an in\-office presence with flexibility.** **This role is not eligible for VISA sponsorship.** **What You Will Do** * Partner with stakeholders to understand business outcomes and translate them into scalable Data \& AI architectures. * Develop solution designs, architecture standards, and implementation guidance that promote consistency, reuse, and delivery speed. * Build alignment and influence decisions across business, product, engineering, security, governance, and platform teams. * Design end\-to\-end data and AI solutions spanning data platforms, integrations, analytics, automation, governance, and AI capabilities. * Apply cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and domain\-oriented design principles. * Identify opportunities where AI can improve decision\-making, productivity, operations, and business outcomes. * Establish architecture patterns, standards, and guardrails that enable secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable solutions. * Apply Harness Engineering principles to embed governance and standards into delivery workflows. * Leverage AI and AI\-DLC practices to accelerate solution exploration, architecture, planning, documentation, and delivery while maintaining ownership of recommendations. * Build and evaluate prototypes, reference implementations, agentic workflows, and technical spikes to validate approaches and reduce risk. * Champion responsible AI practices, including security, privacy, governance, observability, evaluation, and human oversight. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Experience translating business outcomes into scalable Data \& AI architectures and influencing technical direction across teams. * Experience designing end\-to\-end Data \& AI solutions using cloud, data, and AI platforms such as AWS, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies. * Experience advancing platform adoption through product management, developer enablement, or adoption metrics. * Experience using AI and AI\-DLC practices to accelerate solution design, planning, delivery, and decision\-making. * Demonstrated ability to create architecture artifacts and build prototypes, reference implementations, or technical evaluations that validate decisions and reduce delivery risk. * Demonstrated understanding of architecture and responsible AI principles, including security, privacy, governance, observability, resiliency, and supportability; paired with strong stakeholder management and influence skills. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Experience defining and scaling enterprise Data \& AI platform strategies, operating models, and shared capabilities across multiple domains. * Experience applying modern architecture principles, including cloud\-native, API\-first, event\-driven, and domain\-oriented design, as well as AI\-enabled workflows, generative AI, agentic AI, and RAG solutions. * Experience using ontologies, knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or knowledge\-based architectures. * Experience scaling AI\-assisted engineering practices that improve productivity, quality, reliability, or delivery speed. * Hands\-on experience building or operating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or similar standards for connecting AI agents to enterprise systems. * Experience mentoring architects and technical resources to improve architectural decision\-making and consistency. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** Koch creates and innovates a wide spectrum of products and services that make life better. Our work spans a vast number of industries across the world, including engineered technology, refining, chemicals and polymers, pulp and paper, glass, electronics and many more. Headquartered in Wichita, Kansas, Koch employs about 120,000 employees across the globe. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E\-Verify. Please click here for additional information. jobs.title: Lab Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **LIGHT LABS** ============== *Powering a healthier food system through data, transparency, and accountability.* **Lab Operations Engineer** =========================== **Light Labs \| Ann Arbor, MI (On\-site, Lab)** **The Opportunity** ------------------- Are you a software or automation engineer who'd rather be on a lab floor than behind a screen? Someone who looks at a messy operation and sees a system waiting to be built? Then you'd be a great fit as our Lab Operations Engineer. You'll build what we call the Lab Operating System: the most modern, observable, controllable lab operation in the industry. Right now, it's a blank page. You'll own two outcomes, turnaround time and accuracy. That's the role. **Why Light Labs** ------------------ Most labs sell turnaround time. We had to engineer it. Light Labs returns results in about three days where the industry takes seven to fourteen, and today a lot of that speed still depends on people who know where everything is. That won't carry us where we're going. We're scaling to $50M by 2027 and $100M by 2028, and lab capacity is the constraint standing in the way, one we can't solve with headcount. We don't need someone to maintain what exists. We need someone to build what comes next. **What You'll Own** ------------------- You'll walk into a high\-volume, high\-stakes environment with no playbook yet. Your first month is spent on the floor, mapping every process as a system, every checkpoint and every handoff, and standing up a single source of truth for how work actually moves. Then you find the first bottleneck and go after it. What you build first becomes the foundation for everything that follows: * **Build the source of truth.** Real\-time visibility into where every sample is, who owns it, and whether it's on track, no floor\-walking required. * **Find the bottleneck, then kill it.** Locate where time, capacity, or accuracy is being lost, fix it, measure the result, standardize it, repeat. * **Make turnaround time (TAT) predictable.** Build the visibility to catch a late sample before it's late, not after. * **Build proactive quality management.** Real\-time trending and pattern detection for drift, QC failures, and out\-of\-spec results, so errors get caught in the lab instead of by a customer. * **Make partner labs measurable.** Full visibility from shipped to released, with real SLAs and scorecards. * **Bring data to staffing.** Replace reactive staffing with real numbers on coverage, cross\-training, and utilization. * **Systematize method development.** LLM\-assisted workflows for literature review, protocol drafting, SOP generation, and validation. * **Build the playbook, not just the fix.** Everything you build deploys on day one at our next lab, built or acquired. You'll work side by side with our scientists, technicians, and lab leadership, and with engineering and product so the Lab OS plugs into the broader Light Labs platform instead of living on an island. **What You'll Need** -------------------- * **A real software or automation engineering background.** You build systems, pipelines, and integrations other people can run and extend, not a script only you can maintain. * **Real time inside laboratory, scientific, manufacturing, or other complex physical\-world operations.** Pharma, biotech, analytical testing, laboratory automation, and high\-throughput environments are all strong fits, and bioinformatics, computational biology, scientific software, or hands\-on instrumentation experience is an even stronger one. * **A track record of replacing manual workflows with software or automation, personally,** not just adjacent to the work, especially if that's an instrument\-heavy process like LC\-MS or involves pointing AI at a real scientific problem. * **You find the operational problem nobody's defined for you yet,** build the fix, and prove it moved the needle, measurably, ideally on throughput, turnaround time, quality, or efficiency. That's what ownership of an outcome actually looks like here. * **Real communication skills.** You'll be changing how scientists and technicians work. You'll need to explain the why and bring them along, not just go around them. * **Ready to be on the lab floor in Ann Arbor, MI.** This is on\-site, not remote. **Who We Are** -------------- Light Labs is building the modern platform for lab testing, starting with consumer goods brands: cheaper, faster testing that also automates regulatory compliance and drives revenue. Testing is a cost line everywhere else. Here it's a growth line. Brands publish their Light Labs results straight to their own product pages, and those that do have seen conversion lift of around 12%. Hundreds of food and supplement brands already test with us, including AG1, Chomps, David Protein, Seed Health, Momentous, Caraway, and Little Spoon. Consumers deserve to know what's actually in the products that affect their families' health, and transparency is what creates that informed customer  Arbor, MI and Salt Lake City, UT, with headquarters in Austin, TX. We're backed by 8VC and Valor Equity Partners, with CPG founders and strategics in the round. Everyone here, lab tech to engineer to sales, has a seat at the table in making the food system more transparent. **Our Mission** --------------- Everything we consume is getting more toxic and less nutritious, and the problem is invisible. You can't see, taste, or smell it: * Cinnamon apple puree pouches, marketed for children and labeled preservative\-free, kosher, and gluten\-free, contained lead levels 200 times greater than the FDA's proposed guidelines. * 87% of 650 children's food samples tested positive for glyphosate. * Over 1,300 chemicals are banned in cosmetics in the EU, while only 11 are banned in the United States. * The US allows thousands of food additives that are banned in other countries. * A study of 168 baby foods found that 95% contained at least one heavy metal (arsenic, lead, mercury, cadmium), with a quarter containing all four. * Seven out of eight samples of kale tested contained disturbing levels of PFAs, with organic kale containing even higher levels of the toxic compounds. Testing for purity today is slow, expensive, and nearly impossible to interpret without a PhD. No feedback loop means no pressure to change, but if people knew what was actually in their food, they'd shop differently. Nothing changes until someone can measure it, publish it, and be right. That's our mission: real transparency, built with the lab you'd be running. **Founding Team** ----------------- * **Nick Mares,** 2x founder (Kettle \& Fire, a $100M/year brand, and Upside Financing, exited 2022\), $60M\+ raised, CEO and COO experience, Thiel Fellow. * **Vijay Manohar,** helped scale Samsara to $1B ARR and IPO (NYSE: IOT). B.S. computer engineering, UT Austin. **What You Get** ---------------- * Top\-decile salary, plus equity for every employee * Full health, dental, and vision coverage * Generous PTO and company holidays * Direct access to the founders and a promote\-from\-within culture at a company that's adding labs, not consolidating them **Values We're Looking For** ---------------------------- * **First Principles.** We're looking for team members who can deal with ambiguity, deconstruct problems, and build the optimal solution. Question every requirement, delete any part or process you can, simplify and optimize, accelerate cycle time, automate. That same instinct should make you curious enough to ask why something is done a certain way, and forward\-looking enough to notice what won't hold up once we're 5 to 10 times this size. * **Standard of Excellence.** High standards are contagious. A\+ talent attracts A\+ talent. There's a glut of mediocrity in the world. We're chasing after the products and people that strive for excellence. * **Bias for Action.** Take initiative, make decisions quickly, and have a willingness to experiment and learn from failures. Customer expectations aren't static, they rise over time, which means we have to continuously improve every single day. * **Low Ego.** Coachability: it's not about being right, it's about getting to the right answer. React calmly to criticism or negative feedback, treat feedback as an opportunity for information and improvement. Respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when it's uncomfortable, and once a decision is made, commit wholly and move forward. **Why This Role** ----------------- Are you the person who walks into a black box and builds order out of it? Roles like this don't come up often, and the people who can actually do it are rare. If that's you, this is your chance to build the Lab Operating System from the ground up. Apply today. *Light Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

jobs.description: Junior Ai/ML engineer Baton Rouge, LA We are seeking a dynamic and innovative AI/ML Engineer to join our forward\-thinking technology team. In this role, you will lead the development, implementation, and optimization of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning models that drive our data\-driven decision\-making processes. You will harness the power of big data systems, cloud\-based AI services, and advanced statistical modeling to solve complex problems, enhance predictive analytics, and deliver scalable AI solutions across diverse applications. Your expertise will help shape the future of our intelligent systems, ensuring they are robust, efficient, and aligned with strategic business goals. **Duties** * Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models utilizing frameworks such as TensorFlow and Spark to address real\-world challenges. * Implement AI solutions leveraging cloud services like AWS to ensure scalability, reliability, and security. * Conduct statistical analysis and modeling using tools like R and SAS to extract insights from large datasets. * Develop ETL pipelines for data extraction, transformation, and loading from various SQL databases and big data platforms such as Hadoop. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate natural language processing (NLP) capabilities and generative AI into existing products. * Optimize machine learning models through rigorous evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and model training techniques to improve accuracy and performance. * Lead efforts in data mining, database design, and linked data management to support AI/ML initiatives. * Deploy scalable AI models into production environments using Spark implementation and model deployment best practices. * Utilize statistical analysis tools for research purposes to inform model development strategies. * Support data analytics initiatives by applying machine learning/AI\-based analysis for predictive modeling and insights generation. **Requirements** * Proven experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Spark MLlib, or similar platforms. * Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C, Bash (Unix shell), or VBA for automation and model development tasks. * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based AI services on AWS or comparable platforms for model training and deployment. * Deep understanding of big data systems including Hadoop ecosystem components like Hive or Pig; familiarity with Talend for data integration is a plus. * Expertise in statistical modeling, analysis tools like R or SAS, and advanced analytics techniques including unsupervised learning methods. * Knowledge of SQL databases along with experience designing efficient database schemas for large\-scale applications. * Familiarity with natural language processing (NLP), generative AI models, and predictive modeling analysis techniques. * Ability to work with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark implementation for large\-scale data processing tasks. * Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem\-solving skills focused on scalability and performance optimization in AI systems. * Effective communication skills to collaborate across teams on AI implementation strategies and project requirements.
