jobs.title: GIS Supervisor
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Taylorsville\-Bennion Improvement District is seeking an experienced and motivated **GIS Supervisor** to lead the District’s GIS program. This full\-time, exempt position combines hands\-on GIS work, project leadership, database management, and supervision of the GIS team. The GIS Supervisor is responsible for maintaining the integrity and accuracy of District GIS and database information, coordinating GIS/GPS operations, developing maps and applications, supporting District departments, and ensuring assigned projects are completed effectively and on schedule. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead and supervise the GIS team, including work assignments, training, performance, scheduling, and project priorities * Oversee District GIS and database operations and maintain the accuracy, validity, and integrity of GIS information * Plan and manage GIS projects, resources, timelines, budgets, equipment, software, and vendor needs * Design, develop, and maintain GIS map layers, applications, workflows, dashboards, reports, and electronic atlas plats * Review and update maps using as\-built drawings, field verification, GPS data, surveys, plats, property descriptions, and other agency data * Coordinate GIS/GPS activities with District staff, engineers, inspectors, contractors, utilities, and other agencies * Train District employees and GIS staff in GIS software, applications, workflows, and GPS equipment * Respond to after\-hours calls and department emergencies as necessary and help ensure team safety and compliance with District safety standards **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in database operations, computer science, geography, or a related field * Eight (8\) years of work experience performing GIS, database, mapping, or related duties * Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered **Special Qualification** * Associate ArcGIS certification to visualize, manage, and analyze geospatial data through an approved ESRI training center **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong knowledge of GIS, database management, cartography, GPS/surveying practices, and quality assurance/control methods * Proficiency with ESRI/ArcGIS software and related mapping, database, and reporting tools * Ability to lead employees, coordinate projects, establish priorities, and work effectively across departments * Ability to analyze and solve data, mapping, system, and technical problems * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical information clearly * Ability to work effectively with supervisors, directors, employees, engineers, contractors, vendors, and the public **Why Join Us?** We offer a highly competitive compensation package designed to support your health, financial security, and work\-life balance: * **100% Employer\-Paid Health and Dental Insurance** * **Pension Plan \& 401k Match** * **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)** * **Stable, Long\-Term Public Sector Employment** * **Opportunities for Professional Development and Training** * **Supportive Team Environment and Meaningful Public Service Work** **Work Environment** Duties are generally performed indoors under controlled conditions, with periodic field work. The position may involve walking, standing, stooping, sitting, reaching, lifting computer or print materials, and responding to time\-sensitive or emergency needs. Field assignments may include exposure to utility and industrial environments. Interested applicants send resume to bruce@tbid.gov Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $42\.41 \- $65\.74 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement Ability to Commute: * Taylorsville, UT 84129 (Required) Work Location: In person

communications regarding program status, risks, changes, and corrective actions. * Drive customer\-focused decision\-making and execution accountability throughout program lifecycles. **People risk exposure. * Ensure disciplined decision\-making that balances customer needs with business objectives. **Governance \& Operational Excellence** ---------------------------------------- * Ensure compliance with project management processes, PAC governance, launch\-readiness requirements, and portfolio\-management standards. * Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, issue escalation, and corrective\-action management. * Support deployment of best practices, standard work, TEOA principles, and process improvements. * Leverage dashboards, digital tools, analytics, and AI\-enabled capabilities to improve execution effectiveness. **Cross\-Functional Leadership** -------------------------------- * Align Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, Finance, and Product Management teams around program objectives. * Influence organizational decisions affecting customer commitments, business strategy, investments, resources, and execution priorities. * Lead cross\-functional teams in resolving complex technical, operational, and commercial challenges. * Act as a role model for TE Values and leadership behaviors. **What your background should look like** ----------------------------------------- **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field. * 10\+ years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, Product Management, or a related discipline. * 5\+ years of people\-leadership experience in a matrixed environment. * Experience leading complex customer\-facing programs and cross\-functional teams. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic business environment. * Strong business acumen, communication, negotiation, and leadership skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * MBA or advanced degree. * Project Management Professional certification. * Experience within the automotive Tier 1 supplier industry. * Experience managing large\-scale product launches, customer escalations, and portfolio governance. * Experience with project portfolio management systems, analytics tools, and AI\-enabled business processes. **Soft Skills** --------------- * Strategic thinking and business acumen. * Judgment, critical thinking, and decision\-making. * Customer focus and communication for impact. * Program and portfolio leadership. * Talent development, coaching, and inclusive team leadership. * Resource management and management of multiple priorities. * Problem solving and cross\-functional collaboration. * Results orientation, continuous improvement, and value realization. \#TANAUV \#LI\-HYBRID **Competencies** ---------------- SET : future. jobs.title: Applications Engineer - Retrofit
jobs.description: The Retrofit Applications Engineer II is a mid\-level engineer that is responsible for the technical application of TGW products and third\-party equipment to complete mechanical system designs during the quotation phase of projects. This role supports the Retrofit Sales Team to optimally translate customer requirements into a competitive and economically viable intralogistics solution. There will be a design emphasis on expansions, modifications, and modernizations of existing systems. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design medium\-complexity mechatronic layouts using TGW’s product portfolio and relevant third\-party equipment for technically sound and economically efficient proposals. * Develop and redesign hardware systems to meet customer modernization needs. * Conduct performance calculations, warehouse design, equipment selection, and energy efficiency assessments. * Ensure compliance with engineering standards and guidelines in all technical designs. * Act as the technical point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle. * Gather and analyze customer requirements to create tailored intralogistics solutions. * Present and justify technical concepts and proposals to customers. * Conduct on\-site inspections to assess installation conditions and retrofit scenarios. * Create concept, inquiry, and proposal layouts with accurate mechanical costing. * Coordinate with internal departments and external partners during proposal development. * Track schedules proactively and optimize costs during calculations. * Support the sales project team in strategic technical decisions. * Participate in project handovers and provide support during the transition to implementation. * Serve as a reliable technical consultant and central hub for retrofit projects. * Performs additional duties as assigned. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience. **Experience:** Two (2\) to four (4\) years of applications engineering, or related experience, preferably in a material handling environment. **Travel:** Up to 10% travel required. **Skills \& Abilities** * Strong proficiency in 3D computer\-aided design (CAD) software. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.). * AutoCAD (2D CAD) and Sketchup experience preferred. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to remain stationary at a desk for prolonged periods of time. * Ability to go to site frequently and move safely around industrial and/or warehouse environment. * Ability to lift and carry supplies up to 25 pounds at a time. * Ability to operate computers, tablets, phones, and other electronic devices. * Ability to communicate with others verbally and in writing, on a frequent basis. * Ability to tolerate exposure to job site temperature fluctuations due to seasonal weather in geographic region. The physical demands described above are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Other Requirements** This position may require work at TGW customer sites. TGW’s customers may require background checks before accessing their sites. Refusal to participate in a customer\-required background check may result in a customer barring access and a subsequent reduction in work. **Equal Opportunity Employer** TGW Systems Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Supervisor- Test Tower
jobs.description: **Who we are** TK Elevator (TKE) is a world\-leading innovator in vertical transportation and urban mobility. From engineering and installation to maintenance and digital transformation, we support all mobility systems, elevators, escalators, walkways, stairlifts and boarding bridges on any platform, at any time. With digital platforms like AGILE and the IoT platform MAX, we enable smarter, safer urban movement.With more that 50,000 employees, and 1,000\+ global support centers, we are moved by what moves people. TKE – Move Beyond. **TK Elevator** is currently an experienced **Supervisor\- Test Tower** in **Atlanta, GA.** The **Tower Supervisor** is responsible for leading the daily operations of the Elevator Test Tower and Engineering Laboratory, ensuring the safe, efficient, and high\-quality testing, fabrication, assembly, repair, and qualification of elevator systems and components. This role supervises a team of technicians supporting research and development, product validation, prototype builds, troubleshooting, and certification testing for both mechanical and electrical elevator systems. Working closely with Engineering, Product Development, Quality, Manufacturing, and Field Operations, the Tower Supervisor oversees the development of test equipment, installation of complete elevator systems and mockups, laboratory maintenance, and execution of testing protocols while ensuring compliance with company safety standards and applicable industry codes. **ESSENTIALJOB FUNCTIONS:** **Leadership \& Supervision** * Supervise, coach, and develop a team of engineering and mechanical technicians responsible for testing, fabrication, assembly, repair, and installation activities. * Plan, prioritize, and assign daily work to ensure project schedules, engineering milestones, and testing objectives are achieved. * Provide technical guidance while fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. * Conduct performance evaluations, training, and development planning for technical staff. * Ensure compliance with company policies, safety procedures, and laboratory operating standards. **Engineering Test Operations** * Lead technicians in developing, fabricating, assembling, and maintaining specialized test equipment for elevator components, assemblies, and complete elevator systems. * Coordinate installation of elevator subsystems, mockups, prototypes, and complete elevator systems within the test tower. * Partner with engineers and senior technical staff to develop testing methodologies for new products and technologies. * Oversee mechanical and electrical testing activities to validate product performance, durability, reliability, and regulatory compliance. * Ensure testing is conducted in accordance with engineering specifications, quality standards, and applicable industry codes. * Review test plans, monitor execution, and verify accurate documentation of results. **Mechanical Systems Oversight** Supervise testing and qualification of mechanical elevator components including: * Door systems * Hoistway equipment * Suspension systems * Guide rail systems * Machines and brakes * Safety devices * Mechanical assemblies * Support design modifications through fabrication, assembly, troubleshooting, and validation testing. * Oversee construction and modification of mechanical test fixtures. **Electrical Systems Oversight** Supervise testing and qualification of electrical elevator systems including: * Controllers * Drives * Motors * Electrical assemblies * Wiring harnesses * Sensors * Communication systems * Safety circuits * Support engineers in developing electrical test fixtures and validation procedures. * Ensure electrical installations meet engineering specifications and applicable electrical codes. **Fabrication \& Installation** * Oversee fabrication of prototype components and assembly of engineering test fixtures. * Supervise installation, modification, repair, and removal of elevator systems and experimental equipment. * Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and structural modifications required for testing. * Ensure tools, equipment, and materials are available to support engineering projects. **Laboratory \& Facility Operations** * Manage overall operation and maintenance of the Elevator Test Tower and Engineering Laboratory. * Ensure laboratory equipment is maintained, calibrated, and operating safely. * Coordinate preventive maintenance for testing equipment and facility infrastructure. * Maintain an organized, clean, and safe testing environment. * Monitor inventory of tools, materials, and testing supplies. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Collaborate with Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Field Operations on prototype development and product improvements. * Participate in engineering design reviews and provide technical input regarding manufacturability, installation, testing, and serviceability. * Support root cause investigations and corrective actions for product performance issues. * Assist with implementation of continuous improvement initiatives. **Safety \& Compliance** * Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations and company Environmental Health \& Safety requirements. * Maintain compliance with applicable elevator industry standards including ASME A17\.1, CSA, UL, and other applicable regulatory requirements. * Conduct regular safety inspections and promote safe work practices. * Ensure technicians receive required technical and safety training. **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:** * Associate degree in Mechanical Engineering Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, or related technical discipline preferred. * Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. * 7\+ years of progressive technical experience involving elevator systems, mechanical or electrical testing, engineering laboratory operations, or product development. * 3\+ years of supervisory or team leadership experience. * Experience building, installing, repairing, and testing complex mechanical and electrical systems. * Experience supporting engineering development and prototype testing preferred. * Experience with elevator product development and R\&D testing. * Experience supervising engineering laboratory or test facility operations. * Knowledge of ASME A17\.1/CSA B44 elevator code requirements. * Experience with PLCs, motor drives, embedded controls, and automation systems. * Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification is a plus. * Project management experience supporting engineering development initiatives. **This is a safety sensitive position** **What makes us special** At TK Elevator, we offer more than just a role, we offer a place to grow, thrive, and make an impact. Provided they meet all eligibility requirement under the applicable plan documents, employees will be offered * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible spending accounts (FSA) * Health savings account (HSA) * Supplemental medical plans * Company\-paid short\- and long\-term disability insurance * Company\-paid basic life insurance and AD\&D * Optional life and AD\&D coverage * Optional spouse and dependent life insurance * Identity theft monitoring * Pet insurance * Company\-paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Tuition reimbursement * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with company match: Employees can contribute a portion of their pay on a pre\-tax or Roth basis. The company provides a dollar\-for\-dollar match on the first 5% contributed. Additional benefits include: * 15 days of vacation per year * 11 paid holidays each calendar year (10 fixed, 1 floating) * Paid sick leave, per company policy * Up to six weeks of paid parental leave (available after successful completion of 90 days of full\-time employment) Eligibility requirements for these benefits will be controlled by applicable plan documents. This is intended to provide a general description of benefits and other compensation and is not a substitute for applicable plan documents or company policies. TK Elevator is an equal opportunity employer and committed to diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, gender, race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, and veteran status or any other protected status required by applicable law. Applicants with disabilities who require reasonable accommodation in connection with the application process are encouraged to email us directly at ElevatorJobs.ams@tkelevator.com or call 1\-844\-427\-5461\. Important note: TK Elevator is committed to a prejudice\-free and diverse working environment with equal opportunities. We welcome applications from everyone we continously work towards an inclusive and barrier\-free reality. Please do reach out to us and we will work on individual solutions tailored to you. TKE – Move Beyond

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly motivated Data Engineer to join our growing Data Platform team in The Woodlands, Texas. This role will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and curated data products that support enterprise analytics across TWFG. The ideal candidate is passionate about data engineering, cloud analytics, and modern data platform technologies, with experience transforming raw operational data into trusted, business\-ready datasets. You will work closely with software engineers, business analysts, product owners, data developers, and executive stakeholders to deliver high\-impact analytics solutions supporting insurance operations, finance, sales, underwriting, and executive reporting. Key Responsibilities Data Engineering \& Platform Development · Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT/ETL pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and PySpark notebooks. · Develop and optimize lakehouse layers of our Medallion architecture. · Create curated dimensional models, fact tables, and semantic\-ready datasets for reporting and analytics. · Integrate data from internal and external platforms including policy administration systems, carrier systems, vendor platforms, and APIs. · Implement data quality controls, validation frameworks, and monitoring processes. Microsoft Fabric \& Lakehouse Architecture · Develop and maintain Fabric Lakehouses, Mirrored Databases, Dataflows, Notebooks, and Pipelines. · Optimize Direct Lake architectures and semantic model performance. · Support Power BI Embedded analytics and enterprise reporting solutions. · Manage large\-scale datasets and ensure optimal query performance across analytical workloads. Data Governance \& Operational Excellence · Participate in data governance initiatives, metadata management, lineage tracking, and cataloging efforts. · Contribute to CI/CD, testing, release management, and operational monitoring for data assets. · Maintain documentation, data dictionaries, and architecture diagrams. · Promote engineering best practices and reusable development patterns. Required Qualifications Education · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related discipline. · Equivalent professional experience will be considered. Experience · 3\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Data Warehousing. · Experience designing and supporting enterprise\-scale data pipelines. · Strong SQL development skills. · Experience with Python and/or PySpark. · Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Technical Skills · SQL · Python · PySpark · Data Warehousing concepts · ETL/ELT Development · CI/CD practices · REST APIs and data integration Preferred Qualifications · Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric. · Experience with Power BI semantic models and analytics workloads. · Experience with Azure Data Engineering technologies. · Knowledge of Delta Lake, OneLake, and Direct Lake architectures. · Experience implementing Row\-Level Security and enterprise data governance practices. · Insurance, financial services, or highly regulated industry experience. · Familiarity with data cataloging and lineage tools such as Microsoft Purview. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will: · Deliver production\-ready data pipelines supporting critical business functions. · Contribute to the expansion of TWFG's enterprise Microsoft Fabric platform. · Enable new data domains and integrations across agency, policy, carrier, quote, and financial systems. · Improve data quality, reliability, and governance. · Work on certification on our Cloud Provider’s Data platform if not already obtained **Equal Employment Opportunities** TWFG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. **Disclaimer** This job description is not intended to cover all activities, duties, responsibilities and standards of the position and may change at any time with or without notice. jobs.title: Lead Security Systems Technician – Night Shift
jobs.description: **Important Schedule \& Travel Requirements** --------------------------------------------- **This is a night\-shift position.** The typical schedule is **four 10\-hour shifts per week, approximately 8:30 PM–6:30 AM**. Starting either Sunday or Monday night. This position also requires regular overnight travel. Some projects may be located **3–4 hours away from our Petersburg office**, and technicians should expect to stay out of town during the four\-day workweek when required. **Travel time is paid, and per diem is provided for qualifying out\-of\-town work.** Applicants should only apply if they are comfortable working nights and regularly staying out of town during the workweek. **About the Position** ---------------------- Techwise Integrated Security is looking for an experienced **Lead Security Systems Technician** to lead small installation crews on commercial security, alarm, and low\-voltage projects. This is a hands\-on field position. The Lead Technician will typically lead **1–3 other technicians** and will be responsible for keeping the crew productive, completing installations correctly, and communicating progress or issues to the Project Manager. We need someone who understands **alarm systems**, can troubleshoot problems in the field, and can make sound installation decisions with limited supervision. The right candidate should be able to look at a system, understand how the devices are intended to operate, identify wiring or installation problems, and determine practical solutions without needing every step explained. This is a **security and alarm systems installation position, not a traditional electrician position**. **Alarm System Knowledge Is Required** -------------------------------------- Candidates should already understand: * **Normally Closed (NC), Normally Open (NO), and Common (C) contacts** * Alarm relays and dry contacts * End\-of\-line resistors and supervised circuits * Addressable input and output modules * Addressable devices and device addressing * **Data loops / SLC loops** * Proper polarity where applicable * Troubleshooting opens, shorts, grounds, and other common wiring faults * Using a multimeter to troubleshoot low\-voltage alarm circuits * How field devices connect back to control equipment We are not looking for someone who has only pulled cable. The Lead Technician should understand **why devices are wired the way they are and how the system is expected to operate**. **Scissor Lift \& Elevated Work** --------------------------------- A significant portion of this position—often approximately **75% of the installation work—is performed from a scissor lift**. Candidates must be comfortable operating and working from a scissor lift for extended periods, performing overhead installation work, and using tools and handling materials while elevated. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead **1–3 other technicians** on commercial installation projects * Review project drawings, scopes of work, and installation requirements * Plan daily field activities and assign work to crew members * Keep the crew productive and moving toward project completion * Independently troubleshoot installation challenges and unexpected field conditions * Determine practical solutions when site conditions differ from drawings * Communicate project progress, material needs, delays, and field issues to the Project Manager via **email or required\-platforms** * Install and troubleshoot commercial alarm and security systems * Install CCTV and IP camera systems * Install burglar/intrusion alarm, fire alarm, and related systems * Wire and troubleshoot alarm contacts, relays, modules, and field devices * Install and troubleshoot addressable modules and devices * Work with addressable data/SLC loops * Pull, route, terminate, label, and test low\-voltage cabling * Terminate Cat5e/Cat6 cabling using RJ45 connectors * Punch down Cat5e/Cat6 onto patch panels, keystone jacks, and other head\-end equipment * Test and troubleshoot Ethernet cabling * Install cameras, alarm devices, panels, and related equipment * Perform basic conduit, flex, pathway, and cable\-support installation * Read floor plans, construction drawings, and system documentation * Train and assist less\-experienced technicians **Required Experience \& Skills** --------------------------------- * **2\+ years of professional low\-voltage, alarm, security\-system, or related installation experience** * Strong practical understanding of **commercial alarm systems** * Understanding of **NC, NO, and C contacts** * Experience with alarm relays and dry contacts * Understanding of supervised circuits and end\-of\-line resistors * Experience with **addressable modules and devices** * Understanding of **data/SLC loops** * Ability to troubleshoot low\-voltage wiring faults using a multimeter * Ability to work independently with limited supervision * Ability to lead **1–3 other technicians** * Strong field troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Experience installing CCTV or IP camera systems * Ability to crimp RJ45 connectors * Ability to punch down Cat5e/Cat6 cabling * Ability to test and troubleshoot Ethernet cabling * Experience reading project drawings and floor plans * **Comfortable spending extended periods working from a scissor lift** * Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. * Ability to work **8:30 PM–6:30 AM night shifts** * Ability to travel and stay out of town for multiple nights during the workweek * Ability to pass required background checks * Willingness to obtain required Virginia DCJS registration if not already registered **Basic Networking Knowledge** ------------------------------ Because this position includes significant IP camera installation work, candidates should have a basic understanding of: * IP addresses and subnet masks * DHCP and static IP addressing * PoE switches and PoE\-powered devices * Connecting IP cameras to network switches * Determining whether a device has network connectivity * Basic troubleshooting of camera and network connections You do not need to be a network engineer, but you should be comfortable working with IP\-based security equipment. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- The right person for this role understands both **how to install the equipment and how the systems actually work**. We are looking for someone who can troubleshoot alarm circuits, recognize when wiring or device operation does not make sense, make good field decisions without constant supervision, organize a small crew, and know when an issue needs to be escalated to the Project Manager. This position is intended for an experienced technician who can be trusted to understand the system, solve problems in the field, and keep a project moving.

Experience using AutoCAD Civil3D, ArcGIS, and similar programs is preferred. * Must be a highly motivated self\-starter with the ability to work with limited supervision. * Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment with minimal guidance. * Strong analytical and decision\-making abilities with a proven capacity in practical problem solving and ability to compile and analyze technical data. * Capable of working with all levels of the organization and in a team environment. Excellent interpersonal and written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills. * Experience in arctic environments would be considered an asset. Must be willing to work outdoors with a potential exposure to extreme climatic conditions. **Working Conditions:** * **Access:** Fly in, fly out * Schedule: We offer a two\-weeks on / two\-weeks off rotational schedule to support a healthy work\-life balance. * **Accommodation:** Our modern facilities, including dedicated spaces for group and individual physical activities, weights, cardio equipment, movie rooms, theme nights, and modern accommodation complexes. jobs.title: Validation Engineer, Industrial Energy Products
jobs.description: **What to Expect** We are seeking a validation engineer for the site\-level energy controller on our utility\-scale battery sites. That controller runs on embedded Linux. It manages settings, telemetry, and failover, and it talks to utility and SCADA equipment. You will run software\-centric SIL and HIL for it, build that regression with System Integration, and keep the work on the bench. You do not need to have already defined a validation program. You do need the instinct to look at a controller change and suspect which failure would escape, then go prove it. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory. **What You'll Do*** Run software\-centric SIL and HIL for the site\-level energy controller on embedded Linux — settings, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and utility/SCADA communications — so System Integration is testing the site, not the application * Propose the cases worth automating. For a controller change, look for the failures that would escape — restarts, partial writes, timed\-out peers, split state — and do not stop at a suite that only proves the happy path. System Integration and the software team decide which of those become permanent tests * Build that regression with System Integration: automated SIL and HIL that runs against controller builds and catches those cases before they become a system\-test problem. The team writes these tests in pytest * Validate Modbus, DNP3, and SCADA behavior on the bench, including timeouts, bad frames, and peer dropouts, on real equipment where the lab has it and in simulation where it does not * Debug the bench you share. You will not own rack bring\-up, but you will trace a failure from the application through TCP/IP to the port, and you will touch the hardware when that is the fastest way to separate a software bug from a wiring one * When the defect is below the application, follow it far enough to hand off a reproducible case. Kernel and OS depth is learned here. The work stays on the bench: no field deployments, no full\-site signoff **What You'll Bring*** Degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer, or a related field), or equivalent experience * Internship, co\-op, or up to a few years in test, embedded software, or controls. A new graduate with a strong lab or project record qualifies. Five years is not required * Evidence you think about how something fails, not only how to show it works. A project or internship where you found a case the obvious test missed * Some time on a bench, in SIL, or in HIL. You have written or changed a test, not only run one someone else wrote * Networking fundamentals enough to follow a conversation from the application toward the wire, and a willingness to debug on real hardware * One industrial protocol, or proof you can pick an unfamiliar one up quickly. Modbus, DNP3, or SCADA. All three is not required * Able to read code and change a test harness. Our stack includes Go, Rust, and Python. We are language agnostic, and none of these is mandatory * Able to write automated tests. We use pytest. Experience in another framework is fine * Kernel or OS debugging is not required #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance * Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs * Tesla Babies program * Commuter benefits * Employee discounts and perks program #### **Expected Compensation** $120,000 \- $252,000/annual salary \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Tesla Laboratories is a Service\-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Cyber Security, Intelligence Analysis, Financial Management, Facilities Engineering Services, and Program Management support to the Intelligence Community (IC), the Department of Defense (DoD), and other federal government customers. We take pride in fostering a culture that values family, professional growth, and long\-term career development—setting us apart from other services companies. Requirements Tesla Laboratories is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to support Design Technical Support (DTS) services for the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Northwest (NAVFAC NW), Planning Design and Construction Directorate, Design Division (PDC4\). This position supports the existing NAVFAC workforce and provides increased capability for Design\-Bid\-Build and Design\-Build projects and associated efforts undertaken by NAVFAC Perform mechanical engineering tasks, including: Design heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems and plumbing systems for new construction and renovation projects with construction costs exceeding $20M, or design petroleum, oil, and lubricant (POL) systems on projects with construction amounts exceeding $10M. Design a wide variety of HVAC systems/equipment, including variable primary chilled water systems, air\-cooled chillers, water\-cooled chillers, split D\-X, unitary, DOAS, VAV, HVAC controls, and VRF systems. Design a wide variety of plumbing systems, including domestic cold and hot water heating systems, compressed air, and medical gas systems. Apply DoD Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) and use AutoCAD 2022 and Revit 2021\. In addition, the Mechanical Engineer will: Coordinate with team members to execute project scope, create/manage schedules, and track/brief budget execution in conformance with project and customer requirements. Create project technical dashboard reports via Microsoft software (Power BI, Project, Excel, etc.). Facilitate the minimization of project delays by providing technical reviews and recommendations within predetermined timeframes. Research codes, guidance, policies, procedures, processes, criteria, and federal laws/regulations, and provide sound technical recommendations both verbally and in writing. Apply innovative technical principles, practices, and theories to the resolution of technical issues. Coordinate with the Government client, NAVFAC team members, leadership, project stakeholders, and various regulatory agencies. Coordinate and facilitate meetings, make recommendations based on project requirements, coordinate workflow processes, schedule/coordinate Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and effectively communicate findings to project personnel; provide written minutes for all meetings. Review technical reports, RFIs, designs, design changes (design\-build and design\-bid\-build), project deliverables, submittals, and cost proposals from contractors to ensure compliance with customer and RFP requirements. Provide technical support for review of the commissioning plan, design and construction submittals, and field inspections. Provide technical support for construction field activities. Provide a summary of accomplishments during weekly meetings and in a prepared monthly status report. Provide weekly reports documenting technical engineering support and quality assurance on each assigned project, including status, issues, costs, schedule, and findings/observations/recommendations/data collected. Prepare reports, Requests for Proposals, and/or scopes of work in the required format, including applicable attachments, and participate in briefings/conferences. Prepare and deliver briefs supported by necessary project documentation to project team members, base personnel, and senior management. Ensure timely submission of submittals, reviews, and recommendations. Education: Graduate of an accredited Engineering college curriculum (4\-year degree minimum). Experience: Minimum of 6 years of Design Management and/or Design experience performing the tasks described above. It is highly desirable, but not required, to hold a current U.S. Professional Engineering (P.E.) license in the mechanical discipline. Demonstrated knowledge of broad\-based engineering principles and versed in the discipline being hired. Sound understanding of technical concepts, principles, and practices applicable to multi\-disciplined engineering project design. Benefits Tesla Laboratories offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well\-being and long\-term success of our employees, including: Competitive compensation Health, dental, and vision insurance Retirement plan with company contribution Paid time off and federal holidays Professional development and training opportunities Supportive, family\-focused company culture Opportunities for long\-term career growth within a growing SDVOSB

jobs.title: Environmental Technician (Landfill Gas/CQA) – Southern Michigan
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** Tetra Tech is adding an Environmental Technician with interest in landfill gas operations, maintenance, and oversight. This role will be based in and around project sites in Southern Michigan, Northwestern Ohio, and the Greater Midwest Area. **Why Tetra Tech:** At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world. **Your Impact:** Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy. **Position Summary:** As a Field Technician for Tetra Tech, you will be responsible for working on a variety of environmental projects related to environmental protection and remediation, primarily related to solid waste (landfills). The job duties involve collection of complete and usable data for construction activities at our client facilities. Primary responsibilities will be daily documentation of landfill construction projects, including landfill liners and gas collection systems. **Essential Job Functions:** The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. * Adhere to safety policies and programs, and practice safe working procedures. Training and safety equipment will be provided. * Apply critical thinking and problem solving of complex field issues and, under general supervision, provide a proactive approach to client needs and urgent issues. * May cross\-train to perform monitoring, tuning, and maintenance of landfill gas collectors and other infrastructure. * Perform data collection and documentation on a daily basis. * Submit reports using computer software such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and internal company apps. * Work independently to apply general principles to various situations. * Ability to build and retain mutual relationships with clients. **Required Qualifications:** * High School diploma required. * 1\-3 years’ experience in environmental services or related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. * Mechanical and technical aptitude and understanding of field equipment. * Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information orally and respond to questions from peers and supervisors. Good overall communication skills. * Basic math skills for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. * To perform this job successfully, an individual should have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office, email, and other software as necessary to perform job functions. * Remote location in the upper Midwest; based out of Michigan is preferred. * Required to work the same schedule as contractor (various hours up to 60\+ hours a week). **Preferred Qualifications:** * Associates degree in related field preferred. * Being a licensed professional land surveyor in Michigan is a plus but not required. **Physical Requirements:** * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand and walk. The employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear; and taste or smell. * Required to stand and walk during field assignments, including walking on uneven terrain and steep slopes (3:1 or 2:1 grade). * Must be able to lift/move up to 10 lbs regularly, 25 lbs frequently, and 50\+ lbs occasionally. * Requires specific vision abilities including close, distance, peripheral, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. * Fieldwork may involve travel and exposure to outdoor environments; must be physically able to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), including a respirator when required. * An annual medical exam may be required based on the nature of the field assignment. **Work Environment / Environmental Factors:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made. * Walk long distances, up and down steeply sloped landfills and uneven outdoor terrain, while carrying testing/sampling equipment. * Work in extreme (hot and cold, wet or dry) weather conditions safely. * Safely operate/or work in close proximity of heavy equipment. * Be able and willing to work outdoors 40 to 70 hours per week in a variety of weather conditions (45\+ hours for CQA work per week). * Landfill construction quality assurance (CQA) projects require extensive travel demands; therefore, the willingness and availability to be away from home for extended periods of time (e.g., one to three weeks) is required. Work is generally seasonal and projects may not be consistently available. * Work will be conducted both in an outdoor field environment and, on occasion, in the office. Outdoor work will involve potential exposure to various physical and chemical hazards of varying degree and type. * Hearing protection may be necessary. Work may involve the use of PPE, including a respirator. **Additional Information:** * Due to the nature of the position being offered, this offer is contingent upon successful completion of the following: o A background investigation. Please note that this investigation requires your consent and cooperation. o You will be required to drive on a regular basis for Company business you must maintain a safe driving record as defined by Tetra Tech’s Vehicle Safety program. This offer of employment is contingent upon successful evaluation of a motor vehicle (MVR) check. o You will be required to successfully pass a uranalysis drug screen. Tetra Tech Solid Waste East is a zero\-tolerance drug and alcohol business as such you will be subject to quarterly random drug screens where allowable by law (typically not for work in MI). o This offer is also contingent on valid proof of completed OSHA 10 Hour Construction certificate as defined by Tetra Tech. o The job offered to you and its associated essential elements of work; you will be required to pass a comprehensive Medical Examination. o If you have received any health and safety training relevant to this regulation previously, please provide copies of certificates documenting such training. * Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role. * Pay: $21 an hour and any overtime (for work above 40 hours in a week) will be at the 1\.5 Overtime Rate. Pay commensurate with skill level, geography region and experience. **Life at Tetra Tech:** The perks of working at Tetra Tech include: * Comprehensive and market\-competitive benefits. * Merit\-based financial rewards. * Flexibility and company\-wide commitment to work/life balance. * Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees. * Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth. **About Tetra Tech:** Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high\-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 25,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, marital or familial status, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor, and we request priority referral of veterans. We invite applications from all interested parties. Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers. Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, culture, and opportunities: LinkedIn: @TetraTechCareers X (Twitter): @TetraTechJobs Additional Information * Organization: 209 SWE

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Scientific Data Engineering
jobs.description: About the Role We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Scientific Data Engineers (SDE) spread across multiple forward deployed engineering squads and drive both technical and organizational excellence. This role is ideal for a leader who can zoom out to see systemic inefficiencies across teams and processes, then roll up their sleeves to fix them — while also building a culture where engineers do their best work. What You'll Do Team \& People Leadership * Supervise and guide SDEs in each squad in planning, implementation, testing, and documentation. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across teams. * Lead by example \- comfortable with diving deeper into organizational and technical challenges and help the team navigate ambiguity and vagueness. * Manage performance, career development, and org design as teams scale * Hire, mentor, and retain strong engineering talent; build a pipeline of future technical leaders Operational Excellence * Proactively identify inefficiencies in engineering workflows, processes, and cross\-team handoffs — don't wait to be told something is broken * Design and implement systems (planning cadences, metrics, tooling) that increase velocity and reduce friction across teams * Establish and track meaningful engineering metrics (cycle time, deployment frequency, incident rates, etc.) to guide decisions * Drive continuous process improvement, balancing speed with sustainability Technical \& Engineering Excellence * Set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, architecture, testing, and operational reliability across teams * Partner with tech leads and architects on key technical decisions and trade\-offs * Champion best practices in system design, scalability, and maintainability * Stay close enough to the technical details to ask sharp questions and unblock teams when needed Strategy \& Cross\-Functional Partnership * Translate company and product strategy into actionable engineering roadmaps across multiple teams * Partner closely with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to align priorities and timelines * Communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executive leadership * Own budget, headcount planning, and resource allocation for your organization **Requirements** What We're Looking For Required * Overall 10\+ years of work experience, including at least 5 years being a manager or leading through other managers * Proven track record of identifying and resolving operational inefficiencies at scale (process, tooling, or organizational) * Demonstrated commitment to engineering excellence — quality, reliability, and maintainable systems, not just shipping speed * Experience managing managers and building organizational structure as teams grow * Strong technical background with the credibility to engage deeply on architecture and design decisions * Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to executive stakeholders * Experience setting and using engineering metrics to drive decisions and improvements * Comfortable working in a changing environment and navigating through unclear requirements Nice to Have * Experience scaling an engineering org through significant growth (e.g., 2x–5x headcount) * Experience working in startups * Experience in working with life science data * Experience with distributed/remote engineering teams * History of building or maturing engineering processes from scratch (SDLC, release management, incident response) What Success Looks Like in the First Year* Identify key engineering operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies * Engineering teams operate with clear, well\-understood processes and reduced cross\-team friction * Engineering teams able to accurately predict engineering effort and deliver high\-quality products on time * Measurable improvement in key engineering metrics (velocity, quality, reliability) * Engineering is seen as a trusted, proactive partner by Product and executive leadership **Benefits** 100% employer paid benefits for all eligible employees and immediate family members. 401K. Unlimited paid time off (PTO). Company paid Life Insurance, LTD/STD. The salary range for this position is $150K\-$230K USD. The salary range posted reflects our target baseline for this role. Final compensation is determined by a thorough evaluation of factors including the candidate’s specific experience, localized market data, and internal team equity. This position isn't eligible for visa sponsorship

jobs.title: Senior Industrial Estimator - GM Arlington, TX
jobs.description: **The Boldt Company****, a subsidiary of the Boldt Group** **Location: GM Arlington, Texas** At Boldt, we build more than complex projects, and we build strong relationships, great teams, and lasting impact. Join Boldt's automotive and industrial construction team supporting projects at one of the nation's premier automotive manufacturing facilities in Arlington, Texas. As a Senior Industrial Estimator, you will lead preconstruction and estimating efforts for manufacturing, production, facility expansion, process improvement, infrastructure, and capital construction projects. Working closely with owners, engineers, architects, trade partners, and project teams, you'll develop conceptual budgets, detailed estimates, GMP proposals, value engineering solutions, bid strategies, and cost models that help deliver successful projects from planning through construction. The ideal candidate brings experience estimating industrial, manufacturing, automotive, heavy commercial, mission\-critical, or process facility projects and has a strong understanding of construction means and methods, subcontractor procurement, conceptual estimating, quantity takeoffs, cost planning, and risk analysis. Experience with GMP, design\-build, integrated project delivery, BIM tools, and self\-perform construction is highly valued. If you're passionate about construction, enjoy solving complex project challenges, and want to help build the next generation of automotive manufacturing facilities, we'd love to talk with you. If you're an experienced construction professional looking to make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and start a conversation with us. We Are Boldt * **Our People:** We create opportunities for growth, fulfillment, and reaching full potential. * **Our Customers:** We exceed expectations through advocacy, problem\-solving, and collaboration. * **Our Partners:** We collaborate with trust and respect to drive innovation and shared success. * **Our Communities:** We give back with our time, talents, and resources, elevating dignity and doing good Why You’ll Love Working at Boldt * **Employee Owned**: Your work fuels our success and your future * **Purpose**‑**Driven**: ESG‑focused work aligned with strong values * **Better Together**: Teamwork, trust, and shared accountability * **Safety First**: Everyone home safe every day * **Career Growth**: Real development through mentorship and hands‑on learning * **High**‑**Impact Projects**: Complex work that matters * **Lead \& Mentor**: Learn today, lead tomorrow * **Rich Culture**: What started as a carpentry shop has grown into a multi‑million‑dollar company built on relationships and craftsmanship * **High Performance**: By people, strengthened through AI and technology that enhance collaboration, transparency, and results. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ At Boldt, high performance starts with strong relationships. We believe the best projects are delivered by teams that trust each other, communicate openly, and take ownership from the field to the office. Our culture blends accountability with support; where learning, mentorship, and collaboration, drive results. You won’t just contribute to projects that matter; you’ll grow alongside people who are investing in your success. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ What You Bring Candidates whose experience or expertise substantially exceed the requirements of the role are encouraged to apply, as we may have current or future roles which may better align with experience. * **Bachelor's degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.** * **5\+ years of construction estimating experience** supporting industrial, manufacturing, automotive, commercial, or large\-scale capital projects. * **Experience developing conceptual estimates, detailed estimates, budgets, and GMP proposals** for complex construction projects. * **Strong knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, quantity takeoffs, subcontractor procurement, and estimating software** Nice to Have * Experience supporting automotive manufacturing, assembly plant, or large\-scale industrial facility construction projects. * Experience with Design\-Build, Integrated Project Delivery (IPD), or Target Value Design (TVD) project delivery methods. * Working knowledge of BIM and VDC tools such as Revit, Vico, Navisworks, or similar construction technology platforms. * Experience estimating projects within active manufacturing, production, or occupied industrial environments where operations must remain ongoing during construction. Compensation Target Hiring Range: $99,000 \- $132,000 annually Boldt recognizes that experience, expertise, and specialized skills create value. The target hiring range for this position is $99,000 \- $132,000 annually; compensation is determined based on qualifications, experience, certifications, geographic market conditions, internal equity, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. In addition to base compensation, employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus and participation in applicable company benefit programs. Unsolicited Correspondence The Boldt Group and its subsidiaries engage recruiting agencies exclusively through our Enterprise Support Talent Acquisition team and only when a valid, Boldt approved agreement is in place. Boldt does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions at any time, including agencies with an active agreement—unless the submission is expressly requested by the Enterprise Support Talent Acquisition team. Any unsolicited submissions will be deemed the property of The Boldt Group, and no placement fees will be paid. All agency inquiries must be directed to the Enterprise Support Talent Acquisition team. At this time, we are not entertaining any new agency submissions or outreach. EEOC The Boldt Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Inspections Professional Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Purpose** To provide professional engineering review, technical oversight, and signing/sealing of inspection reports prepared by the Inspections and Assessments Department for water and wastewater infrastructure projects. **Essential Duties Responsibilities** **1\. Technical Responsibilities** * Review inspection documentation, field notes, photographs, drone imagery, defect mapping, recommendations, and supporting observations for technical accuracy, completeness, and consistency with CROM standards. * Apply professional engineering judgment to inspection findings, repair recommendations, condition assessments, and report conclusions. * Review, sign, and seal inspection reports in the states where CROM performs work, subject to active licensure and applicable state requirements. * Provide engineering support for inspections of water and wastewater storage tanks, including prestressed concrete tanks, reinforced concrete structures, steel appurtenances, and related infrastructure. * Review inspection exhibits, sketches, defect maps, tables, and supporting visuals for clarity, accuracy, and appropriate engineering support. * Review inspection reports and related technical work prepared by inspection staff prior to client issuance. * Respond to general inquiries. Provide technical responses related to inspection reports, engineering recommendations, and sealed deliverables as requested. **2\. Standards** * Support development and maintenance of standard inspection report language, engineering review procedures, and report quality\-control practices. * Edit and update report templates, technical criteria, and inspection guidance for conformity, quality assurance, and professional engineering requirements. **3\. Leadership Responsibilities** * Active participation in department meetings and completion of assigned department responsibilities. * Coordinate report review priorities, state licensure needs, and signing/sealing workload with the Director of Inspections and Assessments. * Provide technical guidance to inspection personnel regarding report content, engineering conclusions, and documentation needed to support sealed reports. **4\. Professional Conduct/Development** * Maintain professional and technical knowledge through continuing education including reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies and educational workshops at the direction of the department manager. * Participate in applicable code and standard organizations including ACI, AWWA, or ASCE at the direction of the department manager. * Maintain knowledge of water/wastewater industry standards, AWWA guidance, applicable state engineering board requirements, and inspection\-related best practices. * Maintain and enhance the Company’s image through personal demeanor and methods of conducting business. **5\. Other Duties as Assigned** **Minimum Qualifications** * B.S. Degree Civil Engineering or similar ABET/EAC accredited program. * Licensed Professional Engineer with 4\+ years signing and sealing projects. Must hold and maintain active Professional Engineer licensure in applicable states where CROM conducts business, or be able to obtain additional state licensure as needed. * 5 \- 9 years of engineering experience in the water/wastewater industry, structural inspection, tank inspection, repair/rehabilitation, or related infrastructure assessment work. * Proficiency in MS Office suite. * Proficiency reviewing technical reports, engineering recommendations, photographs, tables, and report exhibits in Microsoft Office and related report\-production tools. * Possess high motivation level and strong attention to detail. * Possess effective oral and written communication skills. * Possess effective problem solving and strong mathematical skills. * Ability to work in a team environment. * Ability to perform careful technical review of written reports, photographs, inspection observations, recommendations, and supporting documentation. * Sound professional judgment and willingness to take responsible charge of sealed inspection deliverables within areas of licensure and competency. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with AWWA D110 Type 2 prestressed concrete tanks. * Experience reviewing, signing, and sealing inspection reports or condition assessments for water/wastewater infrastructure. * Master’s degree in Structural Engineering or similar ABET/EAC accredited program. * Experience with concrete tank inspection, repair recommendations, rehabilitation design support, or asset condition assessment. **Working Conditions** This position primarily works in an office setting. There will be occasional travel required. Extended hours will be required as necessary to meet requirements. Report review workload may require coordination across multiple active projects and state licensure requirements. **EEO Statement: CROM, LLC is an equal employment opportunity employer who may provide reasonable accommodation to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. EEO/VETS/DISABILITY**

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer - Hybrid
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Charlotte, NC Category: Data Engineering Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid Job Ref: R2627202\-166 Sr Staff Data Engineer \- GE07DE Staff Data Engineer \- GE07CE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. As a Senior Staff Data Engineer supporting Employee Benefits Sales, you will play a key role in shaping how Sales and Underwriting data is ingested, transformed, and delivered across the organization. You’ll work on modern, cloud‑based data platforms to ensure high‑quality, governed data products that drive operational efficiency, analytics, and decision‑making. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong partnership across Underwriting, Product and Enterprise Data teams. The position offers a strong growth path toward Technical Leadership, with hands\-on ownership of Quote and Underwriting data pipelines and opportunities to mentor and influence across teams. This role will have a Hybrid work schedule, with the expectation of working in an office location (Hartford, CT; Chicago, IL; Columbus, OH; and Charlotte, NC) 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). **Responsibilities:** * Accountable for building small or medium\-scale pipelines and data products. jobs.title: Data Engineer

domains to assist in gathering data requirements and design data solutions * Experience with developing in a multi environment (Dev, QA, Prod, etc.) and leveraging DevOps procedures for code deployment/promotion * Strong understanding of database and data warehouse design, and proficiency utilizing various data platforms, such as PostgreSQL or Snowflake * Experience managing and deploying code using a source control product such as GitLab/GitHub * Able to effectively formulate solutions and communicate complex technical concepts to non technical team members * Proven ability to work collaboratively in a multi\-team environment Desired Qualifications: * Understanding of vector databases or RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures * Experience with analytic systems * large datasets and big data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar • Demonstrated proficiency with API development • Experience with data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow • Knowledgeable on cloud architecture and product offerings, preferably AWS • Experience leveraging containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer jobs.title: Manager, Engineering, Product Acquisition
jobs.description: At Thrivent, we are focused on a digital transformation that will deliver modern, innovative experiences for our clients, financial advisors, and employees. We are investing in data and technology, using DevOps practices, and building an engineering culture of empowered technical experts. Our technologists are involved in work that includes java, react, cloud native development, enterprise integration, automation, cloud data platforms, artificial intelligence, and machine learning as well as maximizing platforms such as Salesforce and AWS. The Engineering Manager for Product Acquisition will help define and drive Thrivent’s Wealth Management and Insurance Product technology strategy and execution. We are looking for a manager with hands\-on technical experience to drive the strategy along with helping coach and mentor a team of engineers. You will lead a team of engineers and will collaborate with other engineering teams within the organization regarding strategy, adoption of our product operating mode, operational excellence, DevOps/engineering maturity, and implementation of the platform. If you are excited and passionate about leading a team to set and drive the Thrivent Digital Advisor Experience forward, apply today! **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Designing Solutions** * Review technical solution design ensuring it aligns with our architecture. Provide guidance and direction to the team. * Take part in system design and architecture conversations with the team to land approaches to deliver solutions. **Developing Software** * Has Developed software. Can read code and stays up to date on best practices. * Ensure code reviews are completed \- Problem solving and analytical skills **Learning and applying new techniques** * Promotes and empowers sharing ideas, best practices, etc ensuring the team has space for these activities. * Anticipates and analyzes trends in technology and assesses the impact of emerging technologies on the business **Collaborating within and across teams** * Supports the team agile practices and learning events / trainings * Helps break down barriers for the team * Builds strong working relationships with peers across teamsUnderstands the desired and actual outcomes as well as the technology delivered by the team * Strong organizational and program management experience. * Partner with Product Manager on Initiatives/ Epics/ Features and provides clarity on desired outcomes as well as technical expertise. * Collaborates with Product manager for strategies, operating plans, targets and measures for product groups * Creates a positive team environment where individuals have psychological safety and work collaboratively while understanding, respecting, challenging and appreciating each other’s ideas **Collaborating across the organization** * Align your team with the priorities of the company and the technology organization for a given product area. **Setting product/platform technology strategy** * Participates in setting the product and platform technology vision, strategies, initiatives, roadmaps , objectives and alignments * Represents the business value of technology upgrades, etc. and influences prioritization in the product roadmap * Empowers the team to select the right tool and platforms for the given product area. **Defining Engineering standards/patterns** * Collaborating with Engineers to ensure adoption of Engineering best practices and promote DevOps practices and automation. * Contributes to the creation of enterprise frameworks and patterns **DevOps** * Define and supports the development Lifecyle processes * Supports the team and removes barriers to resolving production incidents/problems * Ensure DevOps principles via observability, monitoring and alerting * Understands the health of technology products and promotes prioritization of work to maintain and continuously improve * Serve as an escalation point in product level support for ongoing maintenance and production issues **Selecting \& Managing Technology Vendors** * Be an advocate to the team to define criteria’s for selecting the right platform/technology * Guides the team to build consensus on an approach and driving a build vs buy decision with the team. In a buy decision, works with the team to decide on criteria and vendor selection. * Execute or manage the overall technology solutions, platforms for the product groups and associated vendor relationships. **Coaching Engineers** * Holding regular 1:1s with team members and team meeting, * Provides constructive feedback, guidance and coaching to help engineers grow their skills and experience. * Provides career planning advice to engineers and creates development plans to help them achieve their career goals which leverages their skills and capabilities and provides them with learning opportunities. **Recruiting/building talent** * Leads the process of selecting and engaging the right consulting partners * Planning in advance for future people needs for the to our clients. Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients. * Manage a team of direct employees and consultants. **QUALIFICATIONS \& SKILLS:** ***Required:*** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical field or equivalent work experience * 8\+ years of progressively responsible positions in Information Technology including 5\+ years’ experience in software development, portfolio strategy and roadmap development. * 3\+ years’ management/supervisory experience in specific IT functional area discipline, e.g. applications development or equivalent skills leading major technical projects with accountability for enforcing talent management needs and performance standards. * Demonstrated experience and leadership introducing and growing a Product Operating Model (Agile/Scrum). * Demonstrated leadership and experience managing multidiscipline, high\-performance work teams. * Strong competency in project management and execution of multiple or large projects. * Experience working with customers to develop solutions to complex business problems. * Proven ability to communicate effectively with internal/external stakeholders to support business initiatives. * Proven ability to function in an environment which requires flexibility, good judgment and intelligent decision making, often based on limited information and/or extreme conditions. * Ability to formulate, implement and evaluate plans, programs and procedures applicable to customer relationship and demand management. ***Preferred:*** * Direct experience in Life, Health and Annuity insurance products, delivering technology for Financial Advisors. * Series 99 license or above. Pay Transparency Thrivent’s long\-term growth depends on attracting, rewarding, and retaining people who are committed to helping others thrive with purpose. We accomplish this by offering a wide variety of market competitive compensation programs to attract, reward, and retain top talent. The applicable salary or hourly wage range for this full\-time role is $139,455\.00 \- $188,676\.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. The base pay actually offered will be determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to, location, relevant experience, skills, and knowledge, business needs, market demand, and other factors Thrivent deems important. Thrivent is unique in our commitment to helping people to be wise with money and live balanced and generous lives. That extends to our benefits. The following benefits may be offered: various bonuses (including, for example, annual or long\-term incentives); medical, dental, and vision insurance; health savings account; flexible spending account; 401k; pension; life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance; disability insurance; supplemental protection insurance; 20 days of Paid Time Off each year; Sick and Safe Time; 10 paid company holidays; Volunteer Time Off; paid parental leave; EAP; well\-being benefits, and other employee benefits. Eligibility for receipt of these benefits is subject to the applicable plan/policy documents. Thrivent’s plans/policies are subject to change at any time at Thrivent’s discretion. *Thrivent provides Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) without regard to race, religion, color,* *sex**, gender identity, sexual orientation,* *pregnancy,* *national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status,**genetic information, or any* *other**status* *protected by applicable local, state**,* *or federal law. This policy applies to all employees and job applicants.* *Thrivent is* *committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation**,* *please let us know by sending an email to* *human.resources@thrivent.com* *or call* *800\-847\-4836* *and request Human Resources.* \#Remote
